## FINAL

This is the code I will use for my MSc thesis because I am going to fix the issues with my previous code and will allow me to better keep track of everything that I have changed and things that I am investigating versus trying to edit all the code and getting confused about which parts have and have not been changed.

## Loading in the SIMOA

The section I will use to load the dataset that I will use for the analysis.

```{r}
#| label: Loading the SIMOA and Libraries
```

## Eligible Participants

The section where I have set out the inclusion criteria to remove people from the dataset that do not meet our criteria.

```{r}
#| label: Eligible Participants
######
# Participant Inclusion/Exclusion Criteria
# 1. Age ≥65 years (age_cat == 1, or age_cat == 0 with age >= 65)
# 2. Selected at least one of 14 specified BZRAs
# 3. Answered discontinuation outcome (scrn_stopped_bzra)
# 4. Canadian resident (prov_terr != 14)
######

# Ensure dplyr functions take priority (safety check)
select <- dplyr::select
filter <- dplyr::filter
mutate <- dplyr::mutate

# Original count
n_original <- nrow(SIMOA)

# After age filtering (age_cat == 1 means 65+)
SIMOA_age_filtered <- SIMOA %>%
  filter(age_cat == 1 | (age_cat == 0 & age >= 65))
n_after_age <- nrow(SIMOA_age_filtered)

# After c_sp filtering (selecting those who indicated at least one of 14 BZRAs)
SIMOA_c_sp_filtered <- SIMOA_age_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    bzra_selected = rowSums(across(starts_with("c_sp___"), ~ .x == 1), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  filter(bzra_selected > 0) %>%
  select(-bzra_selected)
n_after_c_sp <- nrow(SIMOA_c_sp_filtered)

# After scrn_stopped_bzra filtering
SIMOA_scrn_filtered <- SIMOA_c_sp_filtered %>%
  filter(!is.na(scrn_stopped_bzra))
n_after_scrn <- nrow(SIMOA_scrn_filtered)

# Remove non-Canadian participants (prov_terr == 14)
n_before_prov <- n_after_scrn
SIMOA <- SIMOA_scrn_filtered %>%
  filter(prov_terr != 14)
n_after_prov <- nrow(SIMOA)

# Calculate how many were removed
n_removed_prov <- n_before_prov - n_after_prov

# Summary output
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("SAMPLE INCLUSION/EXCLUSION SUMMARY\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Original sample size:", n_original, "\n")
cat("After age filtering (≥65 years):", n_after_age, " (", round(n_after_age / n_original * 100, 1), "% retained)\n")
cat("After BZRA confirmation:", n_after_c_sp, " (", round(n_after_c_sp / n_after_age * 100, 1), "% retained)\n")
cat("After outcome availability:", n_after_scrn, " (", round(n_after_scrn / n_after_c_sp * 100, 1), "% retained)\n")
cat("After Canadian residency filter:", n_after_prov, " (", round(n_after_prov / n_after_scrn * 100, 1), "% retained)\n")
cat("Non-Canadian participants removed:", n_removed_prov, "\n\n")

# Participant flow (CONSORT-style)
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PARTICIPANT FLOW\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Initial sample:                    ", n_original, "\n")
cat("  ↓ Excluded (age <65):            ", n_original - n_after_age, "\n")
cat("Eligible by age:                   ", n_after_age, "\n")
cat("  ↓ Excluded (no BZRA use):        ", n_after_age - n_after_c_sp, "\n")
cat("Confirmed BZRA users:              ", n_after_c_sp, "\n")
cat("  ↓ Excluded (missing outcome):    ", n_after_c_sp - n_after_scrn, "\n")
cat("With outcome data:                 ", n_after_scrn, "\n")
cat("  ↓ Excluded (non-Canadian):       ", n_removed_prov, "\n")
cat("FINAL ANALYTIC SAMPLE:             ", n_after_prov, "\n\n")

# Total exclusion rate
pct_excluded_total <- 100 * (1 - n_after_prov / n_original)
cat("Total exclusion rate:", round(pct_excluded_total, 1), "%\n\n")

if(pct_excluded_total > 50) {
  cat("⚠️  More than 50% of sample excluded - verify inclusion criteria\n\n")
}

# Save exclusion summary for manuscript
exclusion_summary <- data.frame(
  Step = c(
    "1. Initial sample",
    "2. Age ≥65 years",
    "3. BZRA use confirmed",
    "4. Outcome available",
    "5. Canadian resident",
    "FINAL SAMPLE"
  ),
  N = c(n_original, n_after_age, n_after_c_sp, n_after_scrn, n_after_prov, n_after_prov),
  N_Excluded = c(
    NA,
    n_original - n_after_age,
    n_after_age - n_after_c_sp,
    n_after_c_sp - n_after_scrn,
    n_removed_prov,
    NA
  ),
  Pct_Retained = c(
    100,
    round(100 * n_after_age / n_original, 1),
    round(100 * n_after_c_sp / n_original, 1),
    round(100 * n_after_scrn / n_original, 1),
    round(100 * n_after_prov / n_original, 1),
    round(100 * n_after_prov / n_original, 1)
  )
)

write.csv(exclusion_summary, "sample_exclusion_flowchart.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("✓ Saved: sample_exclusion_flowchart.csv\n\n")

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("✓ Eligibility filtering complete\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
```


## Missing CISS Investigation

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 3: CISS MISSINGNESS INVESTIGATION
#==============================================================================
# Purpose: Investigate missing data pattern in CISS scale
# Key question: Is there systematic dropout at item 10?
#==============================================================================

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("CISS MISSINGNESS INVESTIGATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A. Identify stopping pattern
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("PART A: Identifying where people stopped in CISS\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Create variable showing last CISS item BEFORE FIRST MISSING
SIMOA <- SIMOA %>%
  mutate(
    CISS_last_item_before_dropout = apply(select(., ciss1:ciss21), 1, function(x) {
      if(all(is.na(x))) return(0)  # Didn't start CISS
      first_missing <- which(is.na(x))[1]
      if(is.na(first_missing)) return(21)  # Completed all
      return(first_missing - 1)  # Last item before first missing
    }),
    stopped_at_10 = ifelse(CISS_last_item_before_dropout == 10, 1, 0),
    completed_CISS = ifelse(CISS_last_item_before_dropout == 21, 1, 0),
    started_CISS = ifelse(CISS_last_item_before_dropout > 0, 1, 0)
  )

# Show distribution
cat("Distribution of last CISS item completed BEFORE DROPOUT:\n")
print(table(SIMOA$CISS_last_item_before_dropout, useNA = "ifany"))
cat("\n")

# Show missing by item
cat("Number of people with missing data at each CISS item:\n")
missing_by_item <- sapply(paste0("ciss", 1:21), function(var) {
  sum(is.na(SIMOA[[var]]))
})
names(missing_by_item) <- paste0("Item ", 1:21)
print(missing_by_item)
cat("\n")

# Key statistics
n_total <- nrow(SIMOA)
n_started <- sum(SIMOA$started_CISS, na.rm = TRUE)
n_stopped_10 <- sum(SIMOA$stopped_at_10, na.rm = TRUE)
n_completed <- sum(SIMOA$completed_CISS, na.rm = TRUE)
n_never_started <- n_total - n_started

cat("KEY STATISTICS:\n")
cat("  Total sample size:", n_total, "\n")
cat("  People who never started CISS:", n_never_started, 
    "(", round(100 * n_never_started / n_total, 1), "% of sample)\n")
cat("  People who started CISS:", n_started, 
    "(", round(100 * n_started / n_total, 1), "% of sample)\n")
cat("  People who completed all 21 items:", n_completed, 
    "(", round(100 * n_completed / n_started, 1), "% of starters)\n")
cat("  People who stopped EXACTLY at item 10:", n_stopped_10, 
    "(", round(100 * n_stopped_10 / n_started, 1), "% of starters)\n\n")

# Check for extra missing at item 10 (FIXED)
extra_missing_10 <- missing_by_item[10] - missing_by_item[9]  # Compare to previous item
if(extra_missing_10 > 1) {
  cat("⚠️  ALERT:", extra_missing_10, "additional person(s) missing at item 10 vs item 9\n\n")
}

if(n_stopped_10 > 0) {
  cat("⚠️  WARNING:", n_stopped_10, "people stopped at item 10 - investigate further!\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# B. Compare stoppers vs completers
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("PART B: Comparing people who stopped at item 10 vs completers\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Variables to compare
compare_vars <- c(
  "age", "sex", "gender", "education", "income", "employment",
  "phq2_score", "osss_3_score", "med_quant",
  "dbas1", "reserved", "surps1"
)

# Only include people who started CISS
comparison_data <- SIMOA %>%
  filter(started_CISS == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      stopped_at_10 == 1 ~ "Stopped at 10",
      completed_CISS == 1 ~ "Completed",
      TRUE ~ "Partial (other)"
    )
  )

# Only run comparison if there are people who stopped at 10
if(n_stopped_10 > 0) {
  tab_stopper <- CreateTableOne(
    vars = compare_vars,
    strata = "group",
    data = comparison_data,
    test = TRUE
  )
  
  cat("Comparison of Stopped at 10 vs Completed:\n")
  print(tab_stopper, smd = TRUE)
  cat("\n")
} else {
  cat("No one stopped at item 10 - skipping comparison.\n\n")
  tab_stopper <- NULL
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# C. Examine pattern of missingness across items
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("PART C: Pattern of missingness across CISS items\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Response rates
cat("Response rates by CISS item:\n")
response_rates <- sapply(paste0("ciss", 1:21), function(var) {
  sum(!is.na(SIMOA[[var]])) / n_total * 100
})
names(response_rates) <- paste0("Item ", 1:21)
print(round(response_rates, 1))
cat("\n")

# Drops between consecutive items
drops <- diff(response_rates)
cat("Drop in response rate between consecutive items:\n")
names(drops) <- paste0("Item ", 1:20, "→", 2:21)
print(round(drops, 2))
cat("\n")

# Sharp drop after item 10?
drop_at_10 <- response_rates[10] - response_rates[11]
if(abs(drop_at_10) > 1) {
  cat("⚠️  DROP of", round(drop_at_10, 2), "% between items 10 and 11\n\n")
}

# Visualize missing pattern
cat("Creating missing data visualization...\n")
ciss_data <- SIMOA %>% select(ciss1:ciss21)

png("CISS_missing_pattern.png", width = 1000, height = 600, res = 120)
vis_miss(ciss_data, sort_miss = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "CISS Missing Data Pattern",
    subtitle = paste0("n = ", n_total, " participants")
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
dev.off()
cat("✓ Saved: CISS_missing_pattern.png\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# D. Identify missing data patterns
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("PART D: Types of missing data patterns\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

SIMOA <- SIMOA %>%
  mutate(
    missing_pattern = case_when(
      CISS_last_item_before_dropout == 0 ~ "Never started CISS",
      CISS_last_item_before_dropout == 21 ~ "Completed all CISS",
      CISS_last_item_before_dropout < 21 ~ "Sequential dropout",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

cat("Distribution of missing patterns:\n")
print(table(SIMOA$missing_pattern))
cat("\n")

# Show where sequential dropouts occurred
if(sum(SIMOA$missing_pattern == "Sequential dropout", na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
  cat("Distribution of sequential dropout points:\n")
  SIMOA %>%
    filter(missing_pattern == "Sequential dropout") %>%
    count(CISS_last_item_before_dropout) %>%
    arrange(desc(n)) %>%
    print()
  cat("\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# E. Findings and recommendation
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("FINDINGS AND RECOMMENDATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("FINDINGS:\n")
cat("1. Missing data at CISS item 10:\n")
cat("   - Total missing at item 10:", missing_by_item[10], "people\n")
cat("   - Sequential dropouts AT item 10:", n_stopped_10, "people\n")
cat("   - Extra missing vs item 9:", extra_missing_10, "people\n\n")

cat("2. Pattern identified:\n")
if(n_stopped_10 == 0 & extra_missing_10 <= 1) {
  cat("   ✓ NO EVIDENCE of systematic dropout at item 10\n")
  cat("   ✓ Missing data appears sporadic/random\n")
  cat("   ✓ High completion rate (", round(100 * n_completed / n_started, 1), "%)\n")
} else if(n_stopped_10 > 5) {
  cat("   ⚠️  CONCERNING: ", n_stopped_10, " people stopped at item 10\n")
  cat("   - Investigate survey design at this point\n")
} else {
  cat("   → Small number of dropouts at item 10\n")
  cat("   - Likely random or due to survey fatigue\n")
}
cat("\n")

# Determine recommendation
if(n_stopped_10 == 0 & extra_missing_10 <= 1) {
  recommendation <- "proceed_with_imputation"
  cat("RECOMMENDATION: Proceed with standard imputation\n")
  cat("JUSTIFICATION: Missing data pattern shows no systematic dropout\n")
  cat("at item 10. High completion rate and sporadic missing suggests\n")
  cat("data is likely MAR. Standard MI approaches are appropriate.\n\n")
} else if(n_stopped_10 > 0 & n_stopped_10 <= 5) {
  recommendation <- "proceed_with_sensitivity"
  cat("RECOMMENDATION: Proceed with sensitivity analysis\n")
  cat("JUSTIFICATION: Small number of dropouts at item 10 detected.\n")
  cat("While not alarming, compare results with/without these cases\n")
  cat("to ensure findings are robust.\n\n")
} else {
  recommendation <- "investigate_further"
  cat("RECOMMENDATION: Investigate survey design before proceeding\n")
  cat("JUSTIFICATION: Substantial dropout at item 10 suggests potential\n")
  cat("systematic issue. Review survey flow and consider MNAR.\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# F. Imputation readiness check
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("IMPUTATION READINESS CHECK\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Check percentage missing
pct_missing <- 100 * missing_by_item / n_total
names(pct_missing) <- paste0("ciss", 1:21)

cat("Percentage missing by item:\n")
print(round(pct_missing, 1))
cat("\n")

# Flag high missing
high_missing <- pct_missing[pct_missing > 40]
if(length(high_missing) > 0) {
  cat("⚠️  Items with >40% missing (imputation less reliable):\n")
  print(round(high_missing, 1))
  cat("\n")
} else {
  cat("✓ All items have <40% missing - suitable for imputation\n\n")
}

# Test if outcome is associated with missingness (MNAR test)
cat("Testing if discontinuation is associated with CISS missingness:\n")
SIMOA <- SIMOA %>%
  mutate(any_CISS_missing = ifelse(CISS_last_item_before_dropout < 21, 1, 0))

if(sum(!is.na(SIMOA$scrn_stopped_bzra) & !is.na(SIMOA$any_CISS_missing)) > 0) {
  discont_by_missing <- table(
    Discontinued = SIMOA$scrn_stopped_bzra,
    CISS_Missing = SIMOA$any_CISS_missing
  )
  print(discont_by_missing)
  
  chi_test <- chisq.test(discont_by_missing)
  cat("\nChi-square test: p =", round(chi_test$p.value, 4), "\n")
  
  if(chi_test$p.value < 0.05) {
    cat("⚠️  Discontinuation is associated with missingness - consider MNAR\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("✓ No association - supports MAR assumption\n\n")
  }
}

# Save results
saveRDS(list(
  decision = recommendation,
  n_total = n_total,
  n_started = n_started,
  n_stopped_10 = n_stopped_10,
  extra_missing_10 = extra_missing_10,
  comparison_table = tab_stopper,
  response_rates = response_rates,
  missing_by_item = missing_by_item,
  pct_missing = pct_missing
), "CISS_investigation_results.rds")

cat("✓ Saved: CISS_investigation_results.rds\n\n")

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("✓ CISS investigation complete\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
```

## Personality Missingness

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 4: COMPREHENSIVE MISSINGNESS DIAGNOSTICS
#==============================================================================
# Purpose: Test MAR vs MNAR assumptions for all personality scales
# Determines which variables to include in imputation
#==============================================================================

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("MISSINGNESS PATTERN ANALYSIS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A. Visualize missing data patterns
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("PART A: Visualizing missingness patterns\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Select personality scales
personality_items <- SIMOA %>%
  select(dbas1:dbas_16, reserved:imagination, surps1:surps23, ciss1:ciss21)

# Missingness heatmap
cat("Creating missingness heatmap...\n")
png("missingness_heatmap.png", width = 1400, height = 800, res = 120)
vis_miss(personality_items, cluster = TRUE)
dev.off()
cat("✓ Saved: missingness_heatmap.png\n\n")

# Summary statistics
cat("Missingness by scale:\n")
miss_summary <- data.frame(
  Scale = c("DBAS (16 items)", "BFI (10 items)", "SURPS (23 items)", "CISS (21 items)"),
  N_Missing = c(
    sum(is.na(SIMOA$dbas1)),
    sum(is.na(SIMOA$reserved)),
    sum(is.na(SIMOA$surps1)),
    sum(is.na(SIMOA$ciss1))
  ),
  Percent = c(
    round(100 * mean(is.na(SIMOA$dbas1)), 1),
    round(100 * mean(is.na(SIMOA$reserved)), 1),
    round(100 * mean(is.na(SIMOA$surps1)), 1),
    round(100 * mean(is.na(SIMOA$ciss1)), 1)
  )
)
print(miss_summary)
cat("\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# B. Create missingness indicators
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("PART B: Creating missingness indicators\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

SIMOA <- SIMOA %>%
  mutate(
    miss_DBAS = ifelse(is.na(dbas1), 1, 0),
    miss_BFI = ifelse(is.na(reserved), 1, 0),
    miss_SURPS = ifelse(is.na(surps1), 1, 0),
    miss_CISS = ifelse(is.na(ciss1), 1, 0),
    miss_ANY_personality = ifelse(miss_DBAS + miss_BFI + miss_SURPS + miss_CISS > 0, 1, 0),
    n_personality_missing = miss_DBAS + miss_BFI + miss_SURPS + miss_CISS
  )

cat("Patterns of missingness:\n")
print(table(SIMOA$n_personality_missing))
cat("\n")

cat("People missing at least one scale:", sum(SIMOA$miss_ANY_personality), "\n")
cat("People with complete personality data:", sum(SIMOA$miss_ANY_personality == 0), "\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# C. Test predictors of missingness (MAR assessment)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("PART C: Testing predictors of missingness (MAR assessment)\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

cat("GOAL: If missingness is predicted by observed variables, MAR is plausible.\n\n")

# Define potential predictors (check which exist)
demographic_vars_all <- c(
  "age", "sex", "gender", "prov_terr",
  "education", "income", "employment", "driving_freq", "med_quant", 
  "osss_3_score", "phq2_score"
)

# Only keep variables that exist in dataset
demographic_vars <- demographic_vars_all[demographic_vars_all %in% names(SIMOA)]

cat("Available demographic predictors (", length(demographic_vars), "):\n")
cat(paste("  •", demographic_vars, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")

# Function to test predictors
test_missingness_predictors <- function(miss_var, data, predictors) {
  
  # Remove predictors that don't exist
  available_preds <- predictors[predictors %in% names(data)]
  
  cat("  Testing with", length(available_preds), "predictors\n")
  
  # Formula
  formula_str <- paste(miss_var, "~", paste(available_preds, collapse = " + "))
  
  # Fit model
  model <- tryCatch({
    glm(as.formula(formula_str), data = data, family = binomial())
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("  ⚠️ Model failed:", e$message, "\n")
    cat("  → Trying simpler model (age + sex + education)...\n")
    
    simple_formula <- paste(miss_var, "~ age + sex + education")
    tryCatch({
      glm(as.formula(simple_formula), data = data, family = binomial())
    }, error = function(e2) {
      cat("  ⚠️ Even simple model failed. Skipping.\n")
      return(NULL)
    })
  })
  
  if(is.null(model)) return(list(model = NULL, results = NULL, significant = NULL))
  
  # Get results
  results <- broom::tidy(model) %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    mutate(
      OR = exp(estimate),
      CI_lower = exp(estimate - 1.96 * std.error),
      CI_upper = exp(estimate + 1.96 * std.error),
      sig = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", "")
    ) %>%
    arrange(p.value)
  
  # Significant predictors
  sig_preds <- results %>%
    filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
    pull(term)
  
  return(list(
    model = model,
    results = results,
    significant = sig_preds
  ))
}

# Test for each scale
cat("Testing predictors of DBAS missingness:\n")
miss_DBAS_test <- test_missingness_predictors("miss_DBAS", SIMOA, demographic_vars)
if(!is.null(miss_DBAS_test$results)) {
  print(miss_DBAS_test$results %>% 
          select(term, OR, CI_lower, CI_upper, p.value, sig) %>%
          mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3))))
}
cat("\n")

cat("Testing predictors of BFI missingness:\n")
miss_BFI_test <- test_missingness_predictors("miss_BFI", SIMOA, demographic_vars)
if(!is.null(miss_BFI_test$results)) {
  print(miss_BFI_test$results %>% 
          select(term, OR, CI_lower, CI_upper, p.value, sig) %>%
          mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3))))
}
cat("\n")

cat("Testing predictors of SURPS missingness:\n")
miss_SURPS_test <- test_missingness_predictors("miss_SURPS", SIMOA, demographic_vars)
if(!is.null(miss_SURPS_test$results)) {
  print(miss_SURPS_test$results %>% 
          select(term, OR, CI_lower, CI_upper, p.value, sig) %>%
          mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3))))
}
cat("\n")

cat("Testing predictors of CISS missingness:\n")
miss_CISS_test <- test_missingness_predictors("miss_CISS", SIMOA, demographic_vars)
if(!is.null(miss_CISS_test$results)) {
  print(miss_CISS_test$results %>% 
          select(term, OR, CI_lower, CI_upper, p.value, sig) %>%
          mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3))))
}
cat("\n")

# Compile significant predictors
all_sig_predictors <- unique(c(
  miss_DBAS_test$significant,
  miss_BFI_test$significant,
  miss_SURPS_test$significant,
  miss_CISS_test$significant
))

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("SIGNIFICANT PREDICTORS OF MISSINGNESS:\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

if(length(all_sig_predictors) > 0) {
  cat("Variables that predict missing personality data:\n")
  for(pred in all_sig_predictors) {
    cat("  •", pred, "\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
  cat("INTERPRETATION:\n")
  cat("→ Missingness is related to observed variables\n")
  cat("→ MAR assumption is plausible (conditional on these predictors)\n")
  cat("→ Include these in imputation model\n\n")
  
  missingness_mechanism <- "MAR"
  
} else {
  cat("No significant predictors found.\n\n")
  cat("INTERPRETATION:\n")
  cat("→ Either MCAR or MNAR\n")
  cat("→ Sensitivity analyses are critical\n\n")
  
  missingness_mechanism <- "MCAR_or_MNAR"
}

# Visuali
```




## Variable Combining

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 5: VARIABLE COMBINING & COALESCING
#==============================================================================
# Purpose: Merge current user and former user versions of variables
# Variables affected:
#   - Adverse effects: side_effects, safety, dependence, adls
#   - Withdrawal: stop_wdl_exp (base) + stop_wdl_exp_2 (v2)
#   - COM-B: motivation, desires, capability
#==============================================================================

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("VARIABLE COMBINING & COALESCING\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("BACKGROUND:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("Survey branching logic created two versions of same questions:\n")
cat("  • freq_dich = 2 (stopped): base versions (e.g., side_effects_1)\n")
cat("  • freq_dich = 0 or 1 (current users): v2 versions (e.g., side_effects_1_v2)\n")
cat("  • Withdrawal uses different naming: stop_wdl_exp vs stop_wdl_exp_2\n")
cat("These need to be merged into single variables.\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART A: ADVERSE EFFECTS VARIABLES
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART A: COALESCING ADVERSE EFFECTS VARIABLES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Define variable sets
side_effects_base <- paste0("side_effects_", 1:4)
side_effects_v2 <- paste0("side_effects_", 1:4, "_v2")

safety_base <- paste0("safety_", 1:4)
safety_v2 <- paste0("safety_", 1:4, "_v2")

adl_base <- paste0("adls_", 1:2)
adl_v2 <- paste0("adls_", 1:2, "_v2")

dependence_base <- paste0("dependence_", 1:3)
dependence_v2 <- paste0("dependence_", 1:3, "_v2")

# Function to coalesce and report
coalesce_variables <- function(data, base_vars, v2_vars, var_name) {
  
  cat("Coalescing", var_name, "variables...\n")
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  
  n_merged <- 0
  n_base_only <- 0
  n_v2_only <- 0
  n_both <- 0
  n_neither <- 0
  
  for(i in seq_along(base_vars)) {
    base_var <- base_vars[i]
    v2_var <- v2_vars[i]
    
    # Check if variables exist
    has_base <- base_var %in% names(data)
    has_v2 <- v2_var %in% names(data)
    
    if(has_base && has_v2) {
      # Count patterns before merging
      n_base_only <- n_base_only + sum(!is.na(data[[base_var]]) & is.na(data[[v2_var]]))
      n_v2_only <- n_v2_only + sum(is.na(data[[base_var]]) & !is.na(data[[v2_var]]))
      n_both <- n_both + sum(!is.na(data[[base_var]]) & !is.na(data[[v2_var]]))
      n_neither <- n_neither + sum(is.na(data[[base_var]]) & is.na(data[[v2_var]]))
      
      # Coalesce: take base if available, otherwise v2
      data[[base_var]] <- coalesce(data[[base_var]], data[[v2_var]])
      
      # Remove v2 version
      data[[v2_var]] <- NULL
      
      n_merged <- n_merged + 1
      
    } else if(!has_base && has_v2) {
      # Only v2 exists - rename to base
      data[[base_var]] <- data[[v2_var]]
      data[[v2_var]] <- NULL
      n_merged <- n_merged + 1
      
    } else if(has_base && !has_v2) {
      # Only base exists - keep as is
      n_merged <- n_merged + 1
    }
  }
  
  cat("  Variables merged:", n_merged, "/", length(base_vars), "\n")
  cat("  Responses from base only:", n_base_only, "\n")
  cat("  Responses from v2 only:", n_v2_only, "\n")
  cat("  Responses in both (conflict):", n_both, "\n")
  cat("  Missing in both:", n_neither, "\n")
  
  if(n_both > 0) {
    cat("  ⚠️  Note:", n_both, "cases had both versions answered\n")
    cat("     → Kept base version (stopped users' response)\n")
  }
  
  cat("  ✓ Merged into:", paste(base_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
  
  return(data)
}

# Coalesce each set
SIMOA <- coalesce_variables(SIMOA, side_effects_base, side_effects_v2, "Side Effects")
SIMOA <- coalesce_variables(SIMOA, safety_base, safety_v2, "Safety")
SIMOA <- coalesce_variables(SIMOA, adl_base, adl_v2, "ADL Impact")
SIMOA <- coalesce_variables(SIMOA, dependence_base, dependence_v2, "Dependence")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART B: WITHDRAWAL VARIABLES (SPECIAL HANDLING)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART B: COALESCING WITHDRAWAL VARIABLES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("NOTE: Withdrawal uses different naming pattern:\n")
cat("  • Stopped users (freq_dich=2): stop_wdl_exp___0 through stop_wdl_exp___4\n")
cat("  • Current users (freq_dich=0,1): stop_wdl_exp_2___0 through stop_wdl_exp_2___4\n\n")

# Define withdrawal checkbox variables
withdrawal_base <- paste0("stop_wdl_exp___", 0:4)
withdrawal_v2 <- paste0("stop_wdl_exp_2___", 0:4)

# Check which exist
withdrawal_base_exist <- withdrawal_base %in% names(SIMOA)
withdrawal_v2_exist <- withdrawal_v2 %in% names(SIMOA)

cat("Variables found:\n")
cat("  Base (stop_wdl_exp):", sum(withdrawal_base_exist), "/5\n")
cat("  V2 (stop_wdl_exp_2):", sum(withdrawal_v2_exist), "/5\n\n")

# Coalesce withdrawal checkboxes
if(any(withdrawal_base_exist) || any(withdrawal_v2_exist)) {
  
  cat("Coalescing withdrawal checkboxes...\n")
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  
  n_base_only <- 0
  n_v2_only <- 0
  n_both <- 0
  
  for(i in seq_along(withdrawal_base)) {
    base_var <- withdrawal_base[i]
    v2_var <- withdrawal_v2[i]
    
    has_base <- base_var %in% names(SIMOA)
    has_v2 <- v2_var %in% names(SIMOA)
    
    if(has_base && has_v2) {
      # Count patterns
      n_base_only <- n_base_only + sum(!is.na(SIMOA[[base_var]]) & is.na(SIMOA[[v2_var]]))
      n_v2_only <- n_v2_only + sum(is.na(SIMOA[[base_var]]) & !is.na(SIMOA[[v2_var]]))
      n_both <- n_both + sum(!is.na(SIMOA[[base_var]]) & !is.na(SIMOA[[v2_var]]))
      
      # Coalesce
      SIMOA[[base_var]] <- coalesce(SIMOA[[base_var]], SIMOA[[v2_var]])
      SIMOA[[v2_var]] <- NULL
      
    } else if(!has_base && has_v2) {
      SIMOA[[base_var]] <- SIMOA[[v2_var]]
      SIMOA[[v2_var]] <- NULL
    }
  }
  
  cat("  Responses from stop_wdl_exp only:", n_base_only, "\n")
  cat("  Responses from stop_wdl_exp_2 only:", n_v2_only, "\n")
  cat("  Responses in both (conflict):", n_both, "\n")
  
  if(n_both > 0) {
    cat("  ⚠️  Note:", n_both, "cases had both versions\n")
    cat("     → Kept stop_wdl_exp (stopped users' response)\n")
  }
  
  cat("  ✓ Merged into: stop_wdl_exp___0 through stop_wdl_exp___4\n\n")
  
} else {
  cat("⚠️  No withdrawal variables found\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART C: CREATE WITHDRAWAL COMBINED VARIABLE
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART C: CREATING WITHDRAWAL COMBINED VARIABLE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Define merged variables
wdl_vars <- c(
  none = "stop_wdl_exp___0",
  insomnia = "stop_wdl_exp___1",
  anxiety = "stop_wdl_exp___2",
  mh_other = "stop_wdl_exp___3",
  physical = "stop_wdl_exp___4"
)

# Check if all exist
wdl_vars_exist <- all(wdl_vars %in% names(SIMOA))

if(wdl_vars_exist) {
  
  # Replace NA with 0 (unchecked boxes)
  cat("Replacing NA with 0 for unchecked boxes...\n")
  for(var in wdl_vars) {
    SIMOA[[var]][is.na(SIMOA[[var]])] <- 0
  }
  
  # Create symptom count (excluding "none")
  SIMOA <- SIMOA %>%
    mutate(
      wdl_symptom_count = 
        .data[[wdl_vars["insomnia"]]] + 
        .data[[wdl_vars["anxiety"]]] + 
        .data[[wdl_vars["mh_other"]]] + 
        .data[[wdl_vars["physical"]]]
    )
  
  # Create combined ordinal variable
  SIMOA <- SIMOA %>%
    mutate(
      stop_wdl_exp_combined = case_when(
        # Priority: "no withdrawal" takes precedence
        .data[[wdl_vars["none"]]] == 1 ~ 0,
        # No symptoms checked
        wdl_symptom_count == 0 ~ 0,
        # Single symptoms
        wdl_symptom_count == 1 & .data[[wdl_vars["insomnia"]]] == 1 ~ 1,
        wdl_symptom_count == 1 & .data[[wdl_vars["anxiety"]]] == 1 ~ 2,
        wdl_symptom_count == 1 & .data[[wdl_vars["mh_other"]]] == 1 ~ 3,
        wdl_symptom_count == 1 & .data[[wdl_vars["physical"]]] == 1 ~ 4,
        # Multiple symptoms
        wdl_symptom_count >= 2 ~ 5,
        TRUE ~ 0
      ),
      stop_wdl_exp_combined_factor = factor(
        stop_wdl_exp_combined,
        levels = 0:5,
        labels = c(
          "No withdrawal",
          "Insomnia only",
          "Anxiety only",
          "Other mental health only",
          "Physical effects only",
          "Multiple symptoms (2+)"
        ),
        ordered = TRUE
      )
    )
  
  cat("✓ Created wdl_symptom_count (0-4)\n")
  cat("✓ Created stop_wdl_exp_combined (0-5)\n")
  cat("✓ Created stop_wdl_exp_combined_factor (labeled)\n\n")
  
  # Show distribution
  cat("WITHDRAWAL DISTRIBUTION:\n")
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  
  wdl_table <- table(SIMOA$stop_wdl_exp_combined, useNA = "ifany")
  wdl_labels <- c(
    "0 (No withdrawal)",
    "1 (Insomnia only)",
    "2 (Anxiety only)",
    "3 (Other MH only)",
    "4 (Physical only)",
    "5 (Multiple symptoms)"
  )
  
  for(i in 0:5) {
    if(as.character(i) %in% names(wdl_table)) {
      n <- wdl_table[as.character(i)]
      pct <- round(100 * n / sum(wdl_table[!is.na(names(wdl_table))]), 1)
      cat(sprintf("  %-30s: n=%4d (%5.1f%%)\n", wdl_labels[i+1], n, pct))
    }
  }
  
  if("NA" %in% names(wdl_table)) {
    cat(sprintf("  %-30s: n=%4d\n", "Missing", wdl_table["NA"]))
  }
  cat("\n")
  
  # Symptom count distribution
  cat("SYMPTOM COUNT DISTRIBUTION:\n")
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  count_table <- table(SIMOA$wdl_symptom_count, useNA = "ifany")
  for(i in 0:4) {
    if(as.character(i) %in% names(count_table)) {
      n <- count_table[as.character(i)]
      pct <- round(100 * n / sum(count_table[!is.na(names(count_table))]), 1)
      cat(sprintf("  %d symptoms: n=%4d (%5.1f%%)\n", i, n, pct))
    }
  }
  cat("\n")
  
  cat("CODING SCHEME:\n")
  cat("  0 = No withdrawal effects\n")
  cat("  1 = Insomnia only\n")
  cat("  2 = Anxiety only\n")
  cat("  3 = Other mental health only\n")
  cat("  4 = Physical effects only\n")
  cat("  5 = Multiple symptoms (2+ types)\n\n")
  
} else {
  cat("⚠️  Cannot create combined variable - withdrawal checkboxes missing\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART D: COM-B VARIABLES (Motivation, Desires, Capability)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART D: COALESCING COM-B VARIABLES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("NOTE: These variables measure separate constructs within COM-B framework:\n")
cat("  • Motivation: psychological drivers to stop\n")
cat("  • Desires: personal and social pressure to stop\n")
cat("  • Capability: perceived ability to stop\n")
cat("They will be kept as separate items (no composite scores).\n\n")

# Motivation (3 items)
motivation_base <- paste0("motivation_", 1:3)
motivation_v2 <- paste0("motivation_", 1:3, "_v2")

# Desires (3 items)
desires_base <- paste0("desires_", 1:3)
desires_v2 <- paste0("desires_", 1:3, "_v2")

# Capability (2 items - note unusual naming)
capability_base <- c("capability_1", "capability")
capability_v2 <- c("capability_1_v2", "capability_v2")

# Coalesce motivation
SIMOA <- coalesce_variables(SIMOA, motivation_base, motivation_v2, "Motivation")

# Coalesce desires
SIMOA <- coalesce_variables(SIMOA, desires_base, desires_v2, "Desires")

# Coalesce capability (manual due to naming)
cat("Coalescing Capability variables...\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

n_merged <- 0
for(i in seq_along(capability_base)) {
  base_var <- capability_base[i]
  v2_var <- capability_v2[i]
  
  has_base <- base_var %in% names(SIMOA)
  has_v2 <- v2_var %in% names(SIMOA)
  
  if(has_base && has_v2) {
    SIMOA[[base_var]] <- coalesce(SIMOA[[base_var]], SIMOA[[v2_var]])
    SIMOA[[v2_var]] <- NULL
    n_merged <- n_merged + 1
    cat("  ✓ Merged", v2_var, "→", base_var, "\n")
  } else if(!has_base && has_v2) {
    SIMOA[[base_var]] <- SIMOA[[v2_var]]
    SIMOA[[v2_var]] <- NULL
    n_merged <- n_merged + 1
    cat("  ✓ Renamed", v2_var, "→", base_var, "\n")
  } else if(has_base && !has_v2) {
    n_merged <- n_merged + 1
    cat("  ✓ Kept", base_var, "(no v2 version)\n")
  } else {
    cat("  ⚠️  Neither", base_var, "nor", v2_var, "found\n")
  }
}

cat("  Variables merged:", n_merged, "/", length(capability_base), "\n\n")

# Check which items exist
motivation_exists <- motivation_base %in% names(SIMOA)
desires_exists <- desires_base %in% names(SIMOA)
capability_exists <- capability_base %in% names(SIMOA)

cat("COM-B items successfully merged:\n")
cat("  Motivation:", sum(motivation_exists), "/", length(motivation_base), "\n")
cat("  Desires:", sum(desires_exists), "/", length(desires_base), "\n")
cat("  Capability:", sum(capability_exists), "/", length(capability_base), "\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART E: VERIFICATION & CLEANUP
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART E: VERIFICATION & CLEANUP\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Check for remaining v2 or _2 variables
remaining_v2 <- grep("_v2$|_2___[0-9]$", names(SIMOA), value = TRUE)

if(length(remaining_v2) > 0) {
  cat("⚠️  WARNING: Found remaining v2/_2 variables:\n")
  for(v in remaining_v2) {
    cat("  •", v, "\n")
  }
  cat("\nThese may need manual review.\n\n")
} else {
  cat("✓ No v2 or _2 variables remaining\n")
  cat("✓ All current/former user versions successfully merged\n\n")
}

# Summary of created variables
cat("VARIABLES CREATED/MERGED:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

cat("\nAdverse Effects (merged):\n")
cat("  • Side effects:", paste(side_effects_base, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("  • Safety:", paste(safety_base, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("  • ADL impact:", paste(adl_base, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("  • Dependence:", paste(dependence_base, collapse = ", "), "\n")

cat("\nWithdrawal (merged + combined):\n")
cat("  • Checkboxes:", paste(withdrawal_base, collapse = ", "), "\n")
if("stop_wdl_exp_combined" %in% names(SIMOA)) {
  cat("  • stop_wdl_exp_combined (ordinal 0-5)\n")
  cat("  • wdl_symptom_count (count 0-4)\n")
  cat("  • stop_wdl_exp_combined_factor (labeled)\n")
}

cat("\nCOM-B (merged, kept separate):\n")
if(sum(motivation_exists) > 0) {
  cat("  • Motivation:", paste(motivation_base[motivation_exists], collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
if(sum(desires_exists) > 0) {
  cat("  • Desires:", paste(desires_base[desires_exists], collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
if(sum(capability_exists) > 0) {
  cat("  • Capability:", paste(capability_base[capability_exists], collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

cat("\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART F: SAVE COMBINED DATASET
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART F: SAVING COMBINED DATASET\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Save combined dataset
saveRDS(SIMOA, "SIMOA_combined.rds")
cat("✓ Saved: SIMOA_combined.rds\n\n")

# Create summary
combining_summary <- list(
  adverse_effects = list(
    side_effects = side_effects_base,
    safety = safety_base,
    adl = adl_base,
    dependence = dependence_base
  ),
  withdrawal = list(
    checkboxes = withdrawal_base,
    combined = if("stop_wdl_exp_combined" %in% names(SIMOA)) "stop_wdl_exp_combined" else NULL,
    count = if("wdl_symptom_count" %in% names(SIMOA)) "wdl_symptom_count" else NULL
  ),
  comb = list(
    motivation = motivation_base[motivation_exists],

    capability = capability_base[capability_exists]
  ),
  n_observations = nrow(SIMOA),
  n_variables = ncol(SIMOA),
  remaining_v2 = remaining_v2
)

saveRDS(combining_summary, "variable_combining_summary.rds")

cat("✓ VARIABLE COMBINING COMPLETE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("SUMMARY:\n")

cat("  • Withdrawal: merged stop_wdl_exp + stop_wdl_exp_2, created combined variable\n")
cat("  • COM-B: merged as separate items (no composites)\n")
cat("  • Dataset saved: SIMOA_combined.rds\n")
cat("  • Ready for variable reduction (next chunk)\n\n")
```

## Variable Selection and Preperation

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 6: VARIABLE SELECTION & PREPARATION
#==============================================================================
# Purpose: Select and prepare variables for analysis
# Includes:
#   - Demographics
#   - Health variables (PHQ-2, OSSS-3, general health, medication burden)
#   - Health condition counts
#   - Sleep aid frequency variables
#   - Combined adverse effects, withdrawal, COM-B variables
#   - Personality scales (DBAS, BFI, SURPS, CISS)
#   - Reverse coding of personality items
#==============================================================================

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("VARIABLE SELECTION & PREPARATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Load combined dataset from Chunk 5
if(file.exists("SIMOA_combined.rds")) {
  SIMOA <- readRDS("SIMOA_combined.rds")
  cat("✓ Loaded SIMOA_combined.rds from Chunk 5\n")
  cat("  Dimensions:", nrow(SIMOA), "rows ×", ncol(SIMOA), "columns\n\n")
} else {
  cat("⚠️  SIMOA_combined.rds not found - using SIMOA from memory\n")
  cat("  (Make sure Chunk 5 has been run)\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART A: DEFINE CORE VARIABLE LISTS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART A: DEFINING CORE VARIABLE LISTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Outcome
outcome <- "scrn_stopped_bzra"

# Core demographics
core_demographics <- c("age", "sex", "education", "income", "employment", "driving_freq")

# Health/clinical variables
health_vars <- c("phq2_score", "osss_3_score", "gen_health", "med_quant")

# Sleep aids (will be recoded)
sleep_aids <- c("alc_sleep", "can_sleep", "melatonin_use", "op_sleep")

# Combined adverse effects variables (from Chunk 5)
side_effects_items <- paste0("side_effects_", 1:4)
safety_items <- paste0("safety_", 1:4)
adl_items <- paste0("adls_", 1:2)
dependence_items <- paste0("dependence_", 1:3)

# Withdrawal (combined variable from Chunk 5)
withdrawal_combined <- "stop_wdl_exp_combined"
withdrawal_count <- "wdl_symptom_count"

# COM-B variables (from Chunk 5)
comb_vars <- c(
  paste0("motivation_", 1:3),
  paste0("desires_", 1:3),
  c("capability_1", "capability")
)

# Personality scales
dbas_items <- c("dbas1", paste0("dbas_", 2:16))
bfi_items <- c("reserved", "trusting", "lazy", "relaxed", "few_interests",
               "outgoing", "find_fault", "thorough", "nervous", "imagination")
surps_items <- paste0("surps", 1:23)
ciss_items <- paste0("ciss", 1:21)

cat("✓ Core variable lists defined\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART B: RECODE SLEEP AID FREQUENCY VARIABLES (NA → 0)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART B: RECODING SLEEP AID FREQUENCY VARIABLES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("CODING: 0=Never, 1=<1day/wk, 2=1-3days/wk, 3=4-6days/wk, 4=7days/wk\n")
cat("LOGIC: NA (not asked) = Never uses (0)\n\n")

existing_freq_vars <- sleep_aids[sleep_aids %in% names(SIMOA)]

if(length(existing_freq_vars) > 0) {
  cat("Before recoding - Missingness summary:\n")
  for(var in existing_freq_vars) {
    n_na <- sum(is.na(SIMOA[[var]]))
    pct_na <- round(100 * n_na / nrow(SIMOA), 1)
    cat(sprintf("  %-20s: %3d NAs (%5.1f%%)\n", var, n_na, pct_na))
  }
  cat("\nRecoding NA → 0 (never uses)...\n\n")
  
  for(var in existing_freq_vars) {
    SIMOA[[var]][is.na(SIMOA[[var]])] <- 0
  }
  
  cat("After recoding - Distribution:\n")
  for(var in existing_freq_vars) {
    n_0 <- sum(SIMOA[[var]] == 0)
    n_use <- sum(SIMOA[[var]] > 0)
    pct_use <- round(100 * n_use / nrow(SIMOA), 1)
    cat(sprintf("  %-20s: Never=%3d, Uses=%3d (%5.1f%%)\n", 
                var, n_0, n_use, pct_use))
  }
  cat("\n✓ Sleep aid variables recoded to ordinal (0-4)\n\n")
} else {
  cat("⚠️  No sleep aid frequency variables found\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART C: CREATE HEALTH CONDITION COUNT VARIABLES
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART C: CREATING HEALTH CONDITION COUNT VARIABLES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Check if checkbox variables exist
sleep_conditions_exist <- any(grepl("^sleep_health_con___", names(SIMOA)))
physical_conditions_exist <- any(grepl("^phys_health_con___", names(SIMOA)))
mental_conditions_exist <- any(grepl("^ment_health_con___", names(SIMOA)))

if(sleep_conditions_exist || physical_conditions_exist || mental_conditions_exist) {
  
  # Physical conditions
  if(physical_conditions_exist) {
    phys_cols <- grep("^phys_health_con___", names(SIMOA), value = TRUE)
    phys_cols <- phys_cols[!phys_cols %in% "phys_health_con___0"]
    SIMOA$n_physical_conditions <- rowSums(SIMOA[, phys_cols] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    cat("✓ Created n_physical_conditions from", length(phys_cols), "checkboxes\n")
  } else {
    SIMOA$n_physical_conditions <- 0
    cat("  n_physical_conditions: No checkboxes found, set to 0\n")
  }
  
  # Mental conditions
  if(mental_conditions_exist) {
    ment_cols <- grep("^ment_health_con___", names(SIMOA), value = TRUE)
    ment_cols <- ment_cols[!ment_cols %in% "ment_health_con___0"]
    SIMOA$n_ment_conditions <- rowSums(SIMOA[, ment_cols] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    cat("✓ Created n_ment_conditions from", length(ment_cols), "checkboxes\n")
  } else {
    SIMOA$n_ment_conditions <- 0
    cat("  n_ment_conditions: No checkboxes found, set to 0\n")
  }
  
  # Sleep conditions
  if(sleep_conditions_exist) {
    sleep_cols <- grep("^sleep_health_con___", names(SIMOA), value = TRUE)
    sleep_cols <- sleep_cols[!sleep_cols %in% "sleep_health_con___0"]
    SIMOA$n_sleep_conditions <- rowSums(SIMOA[, sleep_cols] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    cat("✓ Created n_sleep_conditions from", length(sleep_cols), "checkboxes\n")
  } else {
    SIMOA$n_sleep_conditions <- 0
    cat("  n_sleep_conditions: No checkboxes found, set to 0\n")
  }
  
  # Total health conditions
  SIMOA$n_health_conditions <- SIMOA$n_physical_conditions + 
                                SIMOA$n_ment_conditions + 
                                SIMOA$n_sleep_conditions
  cat("✓ Created n_health_conditions (total)\n\n")
  
  # Summary statistics
  cat("Count variable summary:\n")
  cat("  n_physical_conditions: Mean =", round(mean(SIMOA$n_physical_conditions, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      ", Range = [", min(SIMOA$n_physical_conditions, na.rm = TRUE), "-",
      max(SIMOA$n_physical_conditions, na.rm = TRUE), "]\n", sep = "")
  cat("  n_ment_conditions: Mean =", round(mean(SIMOA$n_ment_conditions, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      ", Range = [", min(SIMOA$n_ment_conditions, na.rm = TRUE), "-",
      max(SIMOA$n_ment_conditions, na.rm = TRUE), "]\n", sep = "")
  cat("  n_sleep_conditions: Mean =", round(mean(SIMOA$n_sleep_conditions, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      ", Range = [", min(SIMOA$n_sleep_conditions, na.rm = TRUE), "-",
      max(SIMOA$n_sleep_conditions, na.rm = TRUE), "]\n", sep = "")
  cat("  n_health_conditions: Mean =", round(mean(SIMOA$n_health_conditions, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      ", Range = [", min(SIMOA$n_health_conditions, na.rm = TRUE), "-",
      max(SIMOA$n_health_conditions, na.rm = TRUE), "]\n\n", sep = "")
  
} else {
  cat("⚠️  No checkbox variables found in data\n")
  cat("   Setting all count variables to 0\n\n")
  SIMOA$n_physical_conditions <- 0
  SIMOA$n_ment_conditions <- 0
  SIMOA$n_sleep_conditions <- 0
  SIMOA$n_health_conditions <- 0
}

condition_counts <- c("n_health_conditions", "n_physical_conditions", 
                      "n_ment_conditions", "n_sleep_conditions")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART D: HANDLE GEN_HEALTH VARIABLE
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART D: PROCESSING GEN_HEALTH VARIABLE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Check if gen_health exists in different formats
if("gen_health" %in% names(SIMOA)) {
  cat("✓ gen_health variable exists in dataset\n")
  cat("  Current class:", class(SIMOA$gen_health)[1], "\n")
  
  # Ensure it's an ordered factor with correct levels
  if(!is.ordered(SIMOA$gen_health)) {
    cat("  Converting to ordered factor...\n")
    SIMOA$gen_health <- factor(SIMOA$gen_health,
                                levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
                                labels = c("Poor", "Fair", "Good", "Very good", "Excellent"),
                                ordered = TRUE)
  }
  
  cat("\ngen_health distribution:\n")
  print(table(SIMOA$gen_health, useNA = "ifany"))
  cat("\n")
  
} else if(any(grepl("^gen_health___", names(SIMOA)))) {
  cat("⚠️  gen_health not found as single variable\n")
  cat("   Found checkbox format - converting...\n")
  
  # Create from checkboxes
  gh_cols <- paste0("gen_health___", 1:5)
  gh_cols <- gh_cols[gh_cols %in% names(SIMOA)]
  
  if(length(gh_cols) > 0) {
    # Find which checkbox is selected
    SIMOA$gen_health <- apply(SIMOA[, gh_cols], 1, function(x) {
      which_checked <- which(x == 1)
      if(length(which_checked) == 1) return(which_checked)
      return(NA)
    })
    
    SIMOA$gen_health <- factor(SIMOA$gen_health,
                                levels = 1:5,
                                labels = c("Poor", "Fair", "Good", "Very good", "Excellent"),
                                ordered = TRUE)
    
    cat("✓ Created gen_health from", length(gh_cols), "checkboxes\n")
    cat("\ngen_health distribution:\n")
    print(table(SIMOA$gen_health, useNA = "ifany"))
    cat("\n")
  }
  
} else {
  cat("⚠️  gen_health variable not found in any format\n")
  cat("   This variable will not be available for analysis\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART E: REVERSE CODE PERSONALITY ITEMS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART E: REVERSE CODING PERSONALITY ITEMS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# E1. BFI Reverse Coding
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("BFI Reverse Coding:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("Based on BFI-10 scoring:\n")
cat("  Extraversion: reserved (R), outgoing\n")
cat("  Agreeableness: trusting, find_fault (R)\n")
cat("  Conscientiousness: lazy (R), thorough\n")
cat("  Neuroticism: relaxed (R), nervous\n")
cat("  Openness: few_interests (R), imagination\n\n")

# BFI items to reverse (5 items)
bfi_reverse <- c("reserved", "lazy", "relaxed", "few_interests", "find_fault")

cat("Items to reverse (5-point scale: 1↔5, 2↔4, 3↔3):\n")
for(item in bfi_reverse) {
  if(item %in% names(SIMOA)) {
    cat("  •", item, "\n")
  }
}
cat("\n")

# Reverse code BFI items
if(any(bfi_reverse %in% names(SIMOA))) {
  for(item in bfi_reverse) {
    if(item %in% names(SIMOA)) {
      SIMOA[[item]] <- 6 - SIMOA[[item]]
    }
  }
  cat("✓ Reverse coded", sum(bfi_reverse %in% names(SIMOA)), "BFI items\n\n")
} else {
  cat("⚠️  No BFI items found to reverse code\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# E2. SURPS Reverse Coding
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("SURPS Reverse Coding:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("Hopelessness subscale items (reversed):\n")
cat("  surps1:  'I am content'\n")
cat("  surps4:  'I am happy'\n")
cat("  surps7:  'I have faith that my future holds great promise'\n")
cat("  surps13: 'I feel proud of my accomplishments'\n")
cat("  surps20: 'I feel pleasant'\n")
cat("  surps23: 'I am very enthusiastic about my future'\n")
cat("  NOTE: surps17 ('I feel that I'm a failure') is NOT reversed\n\n")

# SURPS items to reverse (6 items - NOT surps17)
surps_reverse <- c("surps1", "surps4", "surps7", "surps13", "surps20", "surps23")

cat("Items to reverse (4-point scale: 1↔4, 2↔3):\n")
for(item in surps_reverse) {
  if(item %in% names(SIMOA)) {
    cat("  •", item, "\n")
  }
}
cat("\n")

# Reverse code SURPS items
if(any(surps_reverse %in% names(SIMOA))) {
  for(item in surps_reverse) {
    if(item %in% names(SIMOA)) {
      SIMOA[[item]] <- 5 - SIMOA[[item]]
    }
  }
  cat("✓ Reverse coded", sum(surps_reverse %in% names(SIMOA)), "SURPS items\n\n")
} else {
  cat("⚠️  No SURPS items found to reverse code\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# E3. DBAS - No Reverse Coding
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("DBAS Coding:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("DBAS-16 does NOT require reverse coding.\n")
cat("All items scored in same direction (higher = more dysfunctional beliefs).\n")
cat("✓ No DBAS reverse coding needed\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# E4. CISS - No Reverse Coding
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("CISS Coding:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("CISS-21 does NOT require reverse coding.\n")
cat("All items scored in same direction within subscales.\n")
cat("✓ No CISS reverse coding needed\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Summary
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("REVERSE CODING SUMMARY:\n")
cat("  BFI:", sum(bfi_reverse %in% names(SIMOA)), "items reverse coded\n")
cat("  SURPS:", sum(surps_reverse %in% names(SIMOA)), "items reverse coded\n")
cat("  DBAS: 0 items (not needed)\n")
cat("  CISS: 0 items (not needed)\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART F: SELECT FINAL VARIABLES
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART F: SELECTING FINAL VARIABLES FOR ANALYSIS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Compile all variables
all_vars_to_keep <- c(
  outcome,
  core_demographics,
  health_vars,
  condition_counts,
  sleep_aids,
  side_effects_items,
  safety_items,
  adl_items,
  dependence_items,

)

# Check which exist
vars_available <- all_vars_to_keep[all_vars_to_keep %in% names(SIMOA)]
vars_missing <- all_vars_to_keep[!all_vars_to_keep %in% names(SIMOA)]

# Create analysis dataset
SIMOA_analysis <- SIMOA %>% select(all_of(vars_available))

cat("VARIABLE SELECTION SUMMARY:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  Requested:", length(all_vars_to_keep), "variables\n")
cat("  Available:", length(vars_available), "variables\n")
cat("  Missing:", length(vars_missing), "variables\n\n")

if(length(vars_missing) > 0 && length(vars_missing) <= 20) {
  cat("Missing variables:\n")
  for(v in vars_missing) {
    cat("  •", v, "\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
} else if(length(vars_missing) > 20) {

  for(v in head(vars_missing, 20)) {
    cat("  •", v, "\n")
  }
  cat("  ... and", length(vars_missing) - 20, "more\n\n")
}

cat("VARIABLE BREAKDOWN:\n")
cat("  Outcome:", sum(outcome %in% names(SIMOA_analysis)), "/1\n")
cat("  Demographics:", sum(core_demographics %in% names(SIMOA_analysis)), "/", 
    length(core_demographics), "\n")

cat("  Adverse effects:", 
    sum(c(side_effects_items, safety_items, adl_items, dependence_items) %in% names(SIMOA_analysis)), 
    "/13\n")
cat("  Withdrawal:", sum(c(withdrawal_combined, withdrawal_count) %in% names(SIMOA_analysis)), "/2\n")
cat("  COM-B:", sum(comb_vars %in% names(SIMOA_analysis)), "/", length(comb_vars), "\n")
cat("  DBAS:", sum(dbas_items %in% names(SIMOA_analysis)), "/16\n")
cat("  BFI:", sum(bfi_items %in% names(SIMOA_analysis)), "/10\n")
cat("  SURPS:", sum(surps_items %in% names(SIMOA_analysis)), "/23\n")
cat("  CISS:", sum(ciss_items %in% names(SIMOA_analysis)), "/21\n\n")

cat("✓ Created SIMOA_analysis with", ncol(SIMOA_analysis), "variables\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Save analysis dataset
saveRDS(SIMOA_analysis, "SIMOA_analysis.rds")

# Save variable lists
```
