## Diagnostics - MI

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 7: PRE-IMPUTATION DIAGNOSTICS & OPTIMIZATION
#==============================================================================
# Purpose: Comprehensive diagnostics before multiple imputation
# Outputs: Statistically-derived m and maxit, optimized imputation parameters
#==============================================================================

library(mice)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(car)  # For VIF

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PRE-IMPUTATION DIAGNOSTICS & OPTIMIZATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Load prepared dataset from Chunk 6
if(file.exists("SIMOA_analysis.rds")) {
  SIMOA_analysis <- readRDS("SIMOA_analysis.rds")
  analysis_vars <- readRDS("analysis_variable_lists.rds")
  cat("✓ Loaded SIMOA_analysis.rds from Chunk 6\n")
  cat("  Dimensions:", nrow(SIMOA_analysis), "rows ×", ncol(SIMOA_analysis), "columns\n\n")
} else {
  stop("ERROR: SIMOA_analysis.rds not found. Please run Chunk 6 first.")
}

# Verify reverse coding was done
cat("VERIFICATION: Checking reverse coding from Chunk 6\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
if(!is.null(analysis_vars$bfi_reversed) && length(analysis_vars$bfi_reversed) > 0) {
  cat("✓ BFI items reversed in Chunk 6:", length(analysis_vars$bfi_reversed), "\n")
  cat("  Items:", paste(analysis_vars$bfi_reversed, collapse = ", "), "\n")
} else {
  cat("⚠️  No BFI reverse coding detected\n")
}

if(!is.null(analysis_vars$surps_reversed) && length(analysis_vars$surps_reversed) > 0) {
  cat("✓ SURPS items reversed in Chunk 6:", length(analysis_vars$surps_reversed), "\n")
  cat("  Items:", paste(analysis_vars$surps_reversed, collapse = ", "), "\n")
} else {
  cat("⚠️  No SURPS reverse coding detected\n")
}
cat("\n")

# Remove outcome from imputation dataset
outcome <- analysis_vars$outcome
if(outcome %in% names(SIMOA_analysis)) {
  df_imp <- SIMOA_analysis %>% select(-all_of(outcome))
  cat("✓ Removed outcome variable:", outcome, "\n")
  cat("  Imputation dataset:", nrow(df_imp), "rows ×", ncol(df_imp), "columns\n\n")
} else {
  df_imp <- SIMOA_analysis
  cat("⚠️  Outcome variable not found in dataset\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART A: COMPREHENSIVE MISSINGNESS DIAGNOSTICS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART A: COMPREHENSIVE MISSINGNESS DIAGNOSTICS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Calculate missingness statistics
n_total <- nrow(df_imp)
n_vars <- ncol(df_imp)
missing_counts <- colSums(is.na(df_imp))
missing_pct <- 100 * missing_counts / n_total

# Overall missingness
total_cells <- n_total * n_vars
total_missing <- sum(missing_counts)
pct_missing_overall <- 100 * total_missing / total_cells

cat("OVERALL MISSINGNESS:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  Total observations:", n_total, "\n")
cat("  Total variables:", n_vars, "\n")
cat("  Total cells:", total_cells, "\n")
cat("  Missing cells:", total_missing, "(", round(pct_missing_overall, 2), "%)\n")
cat("  Complete cases:", sum(complete.cases(df_imp)), 
    "(", round(100 * sum(complete.cases(df_imp)) / n_total, 1), "%)\n\n")

# Variables with missing data
vars_with_missing <- names(missing_counts[missing_counts > 0])
vars_complete <- names(missing_counts[missing_counts == 0])

cat("VARIABLE-LEVEL MISSINGNESS:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  Variables with missing data:", length(vars_with_missing), "\n")
cat("  Variables complete:", length(vars_complete), "\n\n")

# Missingness categories
cat("MISSINGNESS SEVERITY:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
miss_cats <- cut(missing_pct, 
                 breaks = c(0, 5, 10, 25, 40, 100),
                 labels = c("Minimal (<5%)", "Low (5-10%)", "Moderate (10-25%)", 
                           "High (25-40%)", "Very High (>40%)"),
                 include.lowest = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("  Minimal (<5%%):      %3d variables\n", sum(miss_cats == "Minimal (<5%)", na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  Low (5-10%%):        %3d variables\n", sum(miss_cats == "Low (5-10%)", na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  Moderate (10-25%%):  %3d variables\n", sum(miss_cats == "Moderate (10-25%)", na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  High (25-40%%):      %3d variables\n", sum(miss_cats == "High (25-40%)", na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  Very High (>40%%):   %3d variables\n\n", sum(miss_cats == "Very High (>40%)", na.rm = TRUE)))

# Top 20 variables by missingness
cat("TOP 20 VARIABLES BY MISSINGNESS:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
top_missing <- head(sort(missing_pct[missing_pct > 0], decreasing = TRUE), 20)
for(i in seq_along(top_missing)) {
  cat(sprintf("  %2d. %-30s: %5.1f%% (%4d obs)\n", 
              i, names(top_missing)[i], top_missing[i], 
              round(top_missing[i] * n_total / 100)))
}
cat("\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A1. STATISTICAL DERIVATION OF m (NUMBER OF IMPUTATIONS)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("A1. STATISTICAL DERIVATION OF m\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Calculate optimal m based on missingness
max_miss_pct <- max(missing_pct)
max_miss_var <- names(missing_pct)[which.max(missing_pct)]

cat("METHOD: White et al. (2011) recommend m ≥ percentage of missing data\n")
cat("        Von Hippel (2020) suggests m ≥ 20 for most applications\n")
cat("        Graham et al. (2007) suggest m = 100*FMI (fraction missing info)\n\n")

cat("CALCULATION:\n")
cat("  Highest missingness:", round(max_miss_pct, 1), "% (", max_miss_var, ")\n")
cat("  Average missingness (vars with missing):", 
    round(mean(missing_pct[missing_pct > 0]), 1), "%\n")
cat("  Overall missingness:", round(pct_missing_overall, 2), "%\n\n")

# Calculate based on highest missingness
m_based_on_max <- ceiling(max_miss_pct)

# Calculate based on average missingness
m_based_on_avg <- ceiling(mean(missing_pct[missing_pct > 0]))

# Conservative approach: use max
optimal_m <- max(m_based_on_max, 20)  # Minimum 20

# Cap at reasonable maximum
if(optimal_m > 50) {
  cat("  Initial calculation:", optimal_m, "(capped at 50 for computational efficiency)\n")
  optimal_m <- 50
}

cat("DECISION RULE:\n")
cat("  m based on maximum missingness:", m_based_on_max, "\n")
cat("  m based on average missingness:", m_based_on_avg, "\n")
cat("  Minimum recommended (Von Hippel):", 20, "\n")
cat("  → SELECTED m =", optimal_m, "\n\n")

cat("JUSTIFICATION:\n")
if(optimal_m == m_based_on_max && optimal_m >= 20) {
  cat("  Using m =", optimal_m, "based on highest missingness (", round(max_miss_pct, 1), "%)\n")
  cat("  This ensures adequate imputations for variables with most missing data\n\n")
} else if(optimal_m == 20) {
  cat("  Using minimum m = 20 (Von Hippel, 2020)\n")
  cat("  Maximum missingness is low (", round(max_miss_pct, 1), "%), so 20 is sufficient\n\n")
} else {
  cat("  Using m =", optimal_m, "for computational efficiency\n")
  cat("  Capped from calculated", m_based_on_max, "to balance accuracy and speed\n\n")
}

# Save missingness summary
miss_summary <- data.frame(
  variable = names(missing_pct),
  n_missing = missing_counts,
  pct_missing = missing_pct,
  category = miss_cats
) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_missing))

write.csv(miss_summary, "pre_imputation_missingness_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("✓ Saved: pre_imputation_missingness_summary.csv\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART B: VARIABLE VALIDATION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART B: VARIABLE VALIDATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# B1. Constant and near-zero variance check
cat("B1. Checking for constant/near-zero variance variables\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

constant_vars <- character()
nzv_vars <- character()

for(var in names(df_imp)) {
  if(is.numeric(df_imp[[var]])) {
    non_na <- na.omit(df_imp[[var]])
    n_unique <- length(unique(non_na))
    
    if(n_unique <= 1) {
      constant_vars <- c(constant_vars, var)
      cat("  ⚠️  Constant:", var, "(", n_unique, "unique value)\n")
    } else if(length(non_na) > 0) {
      var_val <- var(non_na)
      if(var_val < 1e-10) {
        nzv_vars <- c(nzv_vars, var)
        cat("  ⚠️  Near-zero variance:", var, "(SD =", round(sqrt(var_val), 6), ")\n")
      }
    }
  } else if(is.factor(df_imp[[var]])) {
    non_na <- na.omit(df_imp[[var]])
    n_levels <- length(levels(df_imp[[var]]))
    n_unique <- length(unique(non_na))
    
    if(n_unique <= 1) {
      constant_vars <- c(constant_vars, var)
      cat("  ⚠️  Single-level factor:", var, "\n")
    }
  }
}

if(length(constant_vars) == 0 && length(nzv_vars) == 0) {
  cat("  ✓ No constant or near-zero variance variables detected\n")
}
cat("\n")

# B2. Minimum sample size check
cat("B2. Checking minimum sample size (non-missing observations)\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

low_n_vars <- character()
for(var in names(df_imp)) {
  n_obs <- sum(!is.na(df_imp[[var]]))
  if(n_obs < 10 && n_obs < n_total) {
    low_n_vars <- c(low_n_vars, var)
    cat("  ⚠️  Low sample size:", var, "(n =", n_obs, ")\n")
  }
}

if(length(low_n_vars) == 0) {
  cat("  ✓ All variables have adequate sample size (n ≥ 10)\n")
}
cat("\n")

# B3. Separation check for binary variables
cat("B3. Checking for separation in binary/categorical variables\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

separation_vars <- character()
for(var in names(df_imp)) {
  if(is.factor(df_imp[[var]]) || (is.numeric(df_imp[[var]]) && 
                                   length(unique(na.omit(df_imp[[var]]))) <= 5)) {
    non_na <- na.omit(df_imp[[var]])
    if(length(non_na) > 0) {
      freq_table <- table(non_na)
      if(any(freq_table < 5)) {
        separation_vars <- c(separation_vars, var)
        cat("  ⚠️  Sparse levels:", var, 
            "(min count =", min(freq_table), ")\n")
      }
    }
  }
}

if(length(separation_vars) == 0) {
  cat("  ✓ No separation issues detected\n")
}
cat("\n")

# B4. SPECIAL HANDLING FOR DERIVED VARIABLES
cat("B4. Handling derived/composite variables\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

# n_health_conditions is a SUM of other condition counts
# It should NOT be imputed or used as a predictor
derived_vars <- c("n_health_conditions")

if(any(derived_vars %in% names(df_imp))) {
  cat("  ISSUE: n_health_conditions is derived (sum of component counts)\n")
  cat("         Using it as predictor creates perfect collinearity\n\n")
  cat("  Removing derived variables from imputation:\n")
  for(var in derived_vars) {
    if(var %in% names(df_imp)) {
      cat("    • ", var, " (will be recalculated post-imputation)\n", sep = "")
      df_imp <- df_imp %>% select(-all_of(var))
    }
  }
  cat("\n  ✓ Derived variables removed\n")
  cat("    Remaining variables:", ncol(df_imp), "\n\n")
  cat("  POST-IMPUTATION: n_health_conditions will be recalculated as:\n")
  cat("    n_health_conditions = n_physical_conditions + n_ment_conditions + n_sleep_conditions\n\n")
} else {
  cat("  ✓ No derived variables to remove\n\n")
}

# Compile problematic variables
problematic_vars <- unique(c(constant_vars, nzv_vars, low_n_vars, derived_vars))

if(length(problematic_vars) > length(derived_vars)) {
  cat("SUMMARY OF PROBLEMATIC VARIABLES (excluding derived):\n")
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  non_derived_problematic <- setdiff(problematic_vars, derived_vars)
  if(length(non_derived_problematic) > 0) {
    cat("  Additional problematic:", length(non_derived_problematic), "\n")
    for(v in non_derived_problematic) {
      cat("    •", v, "\n")
    }
    cat("\n")
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART C: MULTICOLLINEARITY CHECK (VIF) - ALL ELIGIBLE VARIABLES
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART C: MULTICOLLINEARITY CHECK (VIF)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("PURPOSE: High multicollinearity can cause imputation instability.\n")
cat("  • VIF < 5: Acceptable\n")
cat("  • VIF 5-10: Moderate concern\n")
cat("  • VIF > 10: High multicollinearity (consider removing)\n\n")

# Select numeric variables with COMPLETE data for VIF
numeric_complete <- df_imp %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  select(where(~sum(is.na(.)) == 0))

cat("ELIGIBLE VARIABLES FOR VIF (complete numeric only):\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
if(ncol(numeric_complete) > 0) {
  for(i in 1:ncol(numeric_complete)) {
    cat(sprintf("  %2d. %s\n", i, names(numeric_complete)[i]))
  }
  cat("\nTotal eligible:", ncol(numeric_complete), "variables\n\n")
} else {
  cat("  No complete numeric variables found\n\n")
}

if(ncol(numeric_complete) >= 3) {
  cat("Calculating VIF for ALL", ncol(numeric_complete), "eligible variables...\n\n")
  
  vif_result <- tryCatch({
    # Check correlation matrix first
    cor_matrix <- cor(numeric_complete, use = "complete.obs")
    
    # Check for perfect/near-perfect correlations
    upper_tri_cor <- cor_matrix[upper.tri(cor_matrix)]
    max_cor <- max(abs(upper_tri_cor))
    
    if(max_cor > 0.99) {
      cat("  ⚠️  Perfect/near-perfect correlation detected (r =", round(max_cor, 3), ")\n")
      
      # Find which variables are perfectly correlated
      perfect_pairs <- which(abs(cor_matrix) > 0.99 & abs(cor_matrix) < 1, arr.ind = TRUE)
      if(nrow(perfect_pairs) > 0) {
        cat("     Perfectly correlated pairs:\n")
        for(i in 1:min(5, nrow(perfect_pairs))) {
          var1 <- rownames(cor_matrix)[perfect_pairs[i, 1]]
          var2 <- colnames(cor_matrix)[perfect_pairs[i, 2]]
          cat("       •", var1, "↔", var2, "\n")
        }
        if(nrow(perfect_pairs) > 5) {
          cat("       ... and", nrow(perfect_pairs) - 5, "more pairs\n")
        }
      }
      cat("     Skipping VIF due to perfect multicollinearity\n\n")
      NULL
    } else {
      # Calculate VIF using linear model approach
      vif_formula <- as.formula(paste(names(numeric_complete)[1], "~", 
                                      paste(names(numeric_complete)[-1], collapse = " + ")))
      vif_model <- lm(vif_formula, data = numeric_complete)
      car::vif(vif_model)
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("  ⚠️  VIF calculation failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
    cat("     This indicates aliased coefficients (perfect multicollinearity)\n")
    cat("     Proceeding without VIF analysis\n\n")
    NULL
  })
  
  if(!is.null(vif_result)) {
    vif_df <- data.frame(
      variable = names(vif_result),
      VIF = as.numeric(vif_result)
    ) %>%
      arrange(desc(VIF))
    
    cat("VIF RESULTS FOR ALL", nrow(vif_df), "VARIABLES:\n")
    cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
    
    # Print all VIF values
    for(i in 1:nrow(vif_df)) {
      status <- if(vif_df$VIF[i] < 5) "✓" else if(vif_df$VIF[i] < 10) "⚠️" else "✗"
      cat(sprintf("  %s %2d. %-30s: VIF = %6.2f\n",
                  status, i, vif_df$variable[i], vif_df$VIF[i]))
    }
    cat("\n")
    
    # Summary
    high_vif <- vif_df %>% filter(VIF > 10)
    mod_vif <- vif_df %>% filter(VIF >= 5 & VIF <= 10)
    low_vif <- vif_df %>% filter(VIF < 5)
    
    cat("VIF SUMMARY:\n")
    cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
    cat(sprintf("  ✓ Low VIF (<5):        %3d variables (%.1f%%)\n", 
                nrow(low_vif), 100*nrow(low_vif)/nrow(vif_df)))
    cat(sprintf("  ⚠️ Moderate VIF (5-10): %3d variables (%.1f%%)\n", 
                nrow(mod_vif), 100*nrow(mod_vif)/nrow(vif_df)))
    cat(sprintf("  ✗ High VIF (>10):      %3d variables (%.1f%%)\n\n", 
                nrow(high_vif), 100*nrow(high_vif)/nrow(vif_df)))
    
    if(nrow(high_vif) > 0) {
      cat("⚠️  VARIABLES WITH HIGH VIF (>10) - CONSIDER REMOVING:\n")
      for(i in 1:nrow(high_vif)) {
        cat(sprintf("  %2d. %-30s: VIF = %.2f\n", 
                    i, high_vif$variable[i], high_vif$VIF[i]))
      }
      cat("\nHigh VIF indicates these variables are highly correlated with others.\n")
      cat("Consider removing one from each correlated pair.\n\n")
    }
    
    write.csv(vif_df, "vif_analysis.csv", row.names = FALSE)
    cat("✓ Saved: vif_analysis.csv\n\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("ℹ️  Not enough complete numeric variables for VIF analysis\n")
  cat("   (Need at least 3, found", ncol(numeric_complete), ")\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART D: DEFINE VARIABLE TYPES FOR IMPUTATION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART D: DEFINING VARIABLE TYPES FOR IMPUTATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Get variable lists from Chunk 6
continuous_vars <- c(
  "age",
  "med_quant", "phq2_score", "osss_3_score",
  # NOTE: n_health_conditions removed - will be recalculated post-imputation
  "n_physical_conditions", "n_ment_conditions", "n_sleep_conditions",
  "wdl_symptom_count",
  if(!is.null(analysis_vars$dbas)) analysis_vars$dbas else character(),
  if(!is.null(analysis_vars$bfi)) analysis_vars$bfi else character(),
  if(!is.null(analysis_vars$surps)) analysis_vars$surps else character(),
  if(!is.null(analysis_vars$ciss)) analysis_vars$ciss else character()
)

binary_vars <- c("sex")

ordered_vars <- c(
  "education", "income", "employment", "driving_freq",
  "gen_health",
  if(!is.null(analysis_vars$sleep_aids)) analysis_vars$sleep_aids else character(),
  if(!is.null(analysis_vars$adverse_effects)) analysis_vars$adverse_effects else character(),
  "stop_wdl_exp_combined"
)

unordered_categorical <- c(
  paste0("stop_wdl_exp___", 0:4)
)

# Filter to only variables in df_imp
continuous_vars <- continuous_vars[continuous_vars %in% names(df_imp)]
binary_vars <- binary_vars[binary_vars %in% names(df_imp)]
ordered_vars <- ordered_vars[ordered_vars %in% names(df_imp)]
unordered_categorical <- unordered_categorical[unordered_categorical %in% names(df_imp)]

cat("VARIABLE TYPE ASSIGNMENT:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  Continuous (PMM):", length(continuous_vars), "variables\n")
cat("  Binary (logreg):", length(binary_vars), "variables\n")
cat("  Ordered (polr):", length(ordered_vars), "variables\n")
cat("  Unordered categorical (polyreg):", length(unordered_categorical), "variables\n")
cat("  Total:", length(continuous_vars) + length(binary_vars) + 
    length(ordered_vars) + length(unordered_categorical), "\n\n")

# Convert to proper types
cat("Converting variables to proper types...\n")

for(var in continuous_vars) {
  if(!is.numeric(df_imp[[var]])) {
    df_imp[[var]] <- as.numeric(as.character(df_imp[[var]]))
  }
}

for(var in binary_vars) {
  df_imp[[var]] <- as.numeric(df_imp[[var]])
}

for(var in ordered_vars) {
  if(!is.ordered(df_imp[[var]])) {
    df_imp[[var]] <- factor(df_imp[[var]], ordered = TRUE)
  }
}

for(var in unordered_categorical) {
  if(!is.factor(df_imp[[var]]) || is.ordered(df_imp[[var]])) {
    df_imp[[var]] <- factor(df_imp[[var]], ordered = FALSE)
  }
}

cat("✓ Variable type conversion complete\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART E: STATISTICAL DERIVATION OF MAXIT
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART E: STATISTICAL DERIVATION OF MAXIT\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("PURPOSE: Determine iterations needed for convergence.\n")
cat("  • Maxit too low: Imputation hasn't converged (biased estimates)\n")
cat("  • Maxit too high: Unnecessary computation time\n\n")

cat("METHOD: Test small sample imputation to estimate convergence rate\n\n")

# Initialize MICE to get methods
init <- mice(df_imp, maxit = 0, print = FALSE)
method <- init$method
pred <- init$predictorMatrix

# Set methods
for(var in continuous_vars) {
  if(var %in% names(method) && var %in% vars_with_missing) {
    method[var] <- "pmm"
  }
}
for(var in binary_vars) {
  if(var %in% names(method) && var %in% vars_with_missing) {
    method[var] <- "logreg"
  }
}
for(var in ordered_vars) {
  if(var %in% names(method) && var %in% vars_with_missing) {
    method[var] <- "polr"
  }
}
for(var in unordered_categorical) {
  if(var %in% names(method) && var %in% vars_with_missing) {
    method[var] <- "polyreg"
  }
}

# Remove methods for problematic variables
if(length(problematic_vars) > 0) {
  for(var in problematic_vars) {
    if(var %in% names(method)) {
      method[var] <- ""
    }
  }
}

cat("METHOD SUMMARY:\n")
cat("  PMM:", sum(method == "pmm"), "\n")
cat("  Logreg:", sum(method == "logreg"), "\n")
cat("  Polr:", sum(method == "polr"), "\n")
cat("  Polyreg:", sum(method == "polyreg"), "\n")
cat("  Not imputed:", sum(method == ""), "\n\n")

# Run quick test imputation to check convergence characteristics
cat("Running test imputation to assess convergence...\n")

test_imp <- tryCatch({
  mice(df_imp, m = 2, maxit = 20, method = method, predictorMatrix = pred, 
       seed = 12345, printFlag = FALSE)
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("  ⚠️  Test imputation failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
  NULL
})

if(!is.null(test_imp)) {
  # Check for convergence issues in logged events
  if(nrow(test_imp$loggedEvents) > 0) {
    n_convergence_issues <- sum(grepl("convergence|collinearity", 
                                      test_imp$loggedEvents$out, 
                                      ignore.case = TRUE))
    if(n_convergence_issues > 0) {
      cat("  ⚠️", n_convergence_issues, "convergence warnings detected\n")
      cat("     → Recommending higher maxit\n")
      convergence_penalty <- 10
    } else {
      cat("  ✓ No convergence warnings\n")
      convergence_penalty <- 0
    }
  } else {
    cat("  ✓ Test imputation completed without warnings\n")
    convergence_penalty <- 0
  }
  
  # Assess based on data characteristics
  n_vars_to_impute <- sum(method != "")
  avg_missingness <- mean(missing_pct[missing_pct > 0])
  
  cat("\nCONVERGENCE ASSESSMENT:\n")
  cat("  Variables to impute:", n_vars_to_impute, "\n")
  cat("  Average missingness:", round(avg_missingness, 1), "%\n")
  cat("  Complexity score:", round(n_vars_to_impute * avg_missingness / 100, 1), "\n\n")
  
  # Calculate optimal maxit based on data characteristics
  base_maxit <- 20
  complexity_adjustment <- ceiling(n_vars_to_impute / 10) + ceiling(avg_missingness / 2)
  
  optimal_maxit <- base_maxit + complexity_adjustment + convergence_penalty
  
  # Cap at reasonable maximum
  if(optimal_maxit > 50) {
    cat("  Initial calculation:", optimal_maxit, "(capped at 50)\n")
    optimal_maxit <- 50
  }
  
  cat("MAXIT CALCULATION:\n")
  cat("  Base iterations:", base_maxit, "\n")
  cat("  Complexity adjustment:", complexity_adjustment, 
      "(based on", n_vars_to_impute, "variables,", round(avg_missingness, 1), "% missing)\n")
  if(convergence_penalty > 0) {
    cat("  Convergence penalty:", convergence_penalty, "(warnings detected)\n")
  }
  cat("  → SELECTED maxit =", optimal_maxit, "\n\n")
  
  cat("JUSTIFICATION:\n")
  cat("  ", optimal_maxit, "iterations should allow adequate convergence given:\n")
  cat("    • ", n_vars_to_impute, " variables need imputation\n", sep = "")
  cat("    • ", round(avg_missingness, 1), "% average missingness\n", sep = "")
  if(convergence_penalty > 0) {
    cat("    • Convergence issues detected in test run\n")
  }
  cat("  Post-imputation trace plots will confirm convergence\n\n")
  
} else {
  cat("  Using default maxit = 30 (test imputation failed)\n\n")
  optimal_maxit <- 30
  convergence_penalty <- 0
  complexity_adjustment <- 10
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART F: SAVE OPTIMIZATION RESULTS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART F: SAVING OPTIMIZATION RESULTS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Save optimized imputation dataset
saveRDS(df_imp, "df_imputation_ready.rds")
cat("✓ Saved: df_imputation_ready.rds\n")

# Save optimal parameters
imputation_parameters <- list(
  optimal_m = optimal_m,
  optimal_m_justification = paste0(
    "Based on max missingness (", round(max_miss_pct, 1), "%). ",
    "White et al. (2011): m ≥ % missing. ",
    "Min 20 (Von Hippel, 2020)."
  ),
  optimal_maxit = optimal_maxit,
  optimal_maxit_justification = paste0(
    "Derived from: base (20) + complexity (", 
    complexity_adjustment,
    ") + penalties (", 
    convergence_penalty,
    "). Based on ", sum(method != ""), " variables, ",
    round(mean(missing_pct[missing_pct > 0]), 1), "% avg missingness."
  ),
  method = method,
  predictor_matrix = pred,
  variable_types = list(
    continuous = continuous_vars,
    binary = binary_vars,
    ordered = ordered_vars,
    unordered = unordered_categorical
  ),
  excluded_variables = c(outcome, problematic_vars),
  derived_variables_to_recalculate = derived_vars,
  n_observations = nrow(df_imp),
  n_variables = ncol(df_imp),
  n_vars_to_impute = sum(method != ""),
  max_missingness_pct = max_miss_pct,
  avg_missingness_pct = mean(missing_pct[missing_pct > 0]),
  reverse_coding_done = list(
    bfi = analysis_vars$bfi_reversed,
    surps = analysis_vars$surps_reversed
  )
)

saveRDS(imputation_parameters, "imputation_parameters_optimized.rds")
cat("✓ Saved: imputation_parameters_optimized.rds\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART G: FINAL SUMMARY
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("DIAGNOSTICS COMPLETE - SUMMARY\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("STATISTICALLY-DERIVED PARAMETERS:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  • m =", optimal_m, "(based on", round(max_miss_pct, 1), "% max missingness)\n")
cat("  • maxit =", optimal_maxit, "(based on complexity assessment)\n")
cat("  • Variables to impute:", sum(method != ""), "\n")
cat("  • Observations:", nrow(df_imp), "\n\n")

cat("VARIABLE BREAKDOWN:\n")
cat("  • Continuous (PMM):", sum(method == "pmm"), "\n")
cat("  • Binary (logreg):", sum(method == "logreg"), "\n")
cat("  • Ordered (polr):", sum(method == "polr"), "\n")
cat("  • Unordered (polyreg):", sum(method == "polyreg"), "\n")
cat("  • Not imputed:", sum(method == ""), "\n\n")

if(length(problematic_vars) > 0) {
  cat("EXCLUDED VARIABLES:\n")
  cat("  • Problematic:", length(setdiff(problematic_vars, derived_vars)), "\n")
  cat("  • Derived (to recalculate):", length(derived_vars), "\n")
  for(v in derived_vars) {
    cat("    - ", v, "\n", sep = "")
  }
  cat("  • Outcome:", outcome, "\n\n")
}

cat("REVERSE CODING STATUS:\n")
cat("  • BFI items already reversed in Chunk 6:", length(analysis_vars$bfi_reversed), "\n")
cat("  • SURPS items already reversed in Chunk 6:", length(analysis_vars$surps_reversed), "\n")
cat("  • NO additional reverse coding needed in Chunk 8\n\n")

cat("FILES CREATED:\n")
cat("  1. df_imputation_ready.rds - Dataset ready for imputation\n")
cat("  2. imputation_parameters_optimized.rds - Statistically-derived parameters\n")
cat("  3. pre_imputation_missingness_summary.csv - Detailed missingness\n")
if(file.exists("vif_analysis.csv")) {
  cat("  4. vif_analysis.csv - Multicollinearity assessment (ALL eligible variables)\n")
}
cat("\n")

cat("NEXT STEP: Proceed to Chunk 8 (Multiple Imputation)\n\n")

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("✓ PRE-IMPUTATION DIAGNOSTICS COMPLETE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
```



## MI

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 8: MULTIPLE IMPUTATION
#==============================================================================
# Purpose: Perform multiple imputation using MICE with optimized parameters
# Outputs: Imputed datasets with convergence diagnostics
#==============================================================================

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("MULTIPLE IMPUTATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Load optimized parameters from Chunk 7
if(!file.exists("df_imputation_ready.rds") || !file.exists("imputation_parameters_optimized.rds")) {
  stop("ERROR: Required files not found. Please run Chunk 7 first.")
}

df_imp <- readRDS("df_imputation_ready.rds")
imp_params <- readRDS("imputation_parameters_optimized.rds")

cat("✓ Loaded imputation-ready dataset\n")
cat("  Dimensions:", nrow(df_imp), "rows ×", ncol(df_imp), "columns\n\n")

  data = df_imp,

  method = imp_params$method,

  cat("\n  Event types:\n")
  for(event in names(event_summary)) {
    cat("    •", event, ":", event_summary[event], "times\n")
  }
  
  # Show first few events

)

cat("Calculating imputation diagnostics...\n\n")

# Get imputed values statistics
complete_data <- complete(imp_final, action = "long", include = TRUE)

# Calculate mean and SD for imputed vs observed for key variables
quality_assessment <- data.frame()

for(var in continuous_to_plot) {
  if(var %in% names(df_imp)) {
    # Observed values
    obs_mean <- mean(df_imp[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
    obs_sd <- sd(df_imp[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Imputed values (from all imputations)
    imputed_only <- complete_data[complete_data$.imp > 0 & is.na(df_imp[[var]][complete_data$.id]), ]
    
    if(nrow(imputed_only) > 0) {
      imp_mean <- mean(imputed_only[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
      imp_sd <- sd(imputed_only[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
      
      quality_assessment <- rbind(quality_assessment, data.frame(
        variable = var,
        observed_mean = obs_mean,
        observed_sd = obs_sd,
        imputed_mean = imp_mean,
        imputed_sd = imp_sd,
        mean_diff = imp_mean - obs_mean,
        sd_ratio = imp_sd / obs_sd
      ))
    }
  }
}

if(nrow(quality_assessment) > 0) {
  cat("QUALITY METRICS (Continuous Variables):\n")
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

  cat("  • mean_diff close to 0 = good agreement\n")
  cat("  • sd_ratio close to 1.0 = similar variability\n")
  cat("  • Large deviations may indicate issues\n\n")
}

    # Get the i-th imputed dataset
    imp_data <- complete(imp_final, i)
    
    # Recalculate n_health_conditions
    imp_data$n_health_conditions <- imp_data$n_physical_conditions + 
                                     imp_data$n_ment_conditions + 
                                     imp_data$n_sleep_conditions
    
    # Put it back into the mids object
    imp_final$data <- imp_data
    
    # Store in the appropriate slot
    if(i == 1) {
      # Initialize the storage
      imp_final$data$n_health_conditions <- imp_data$n_health_conditions
    }
  }
  
  # Add n_health_conditions to all complete datasets
  for(i in 1:imp_params$optimal_m) {
    imp_data <- complete(imp_final, i)
    imp_data$n_health_conditions <- imp_data$n_physical_conditions + 
                                     imp_data$n_ment_conditions + 
                                     imp_data$n_sleep_conditions
    
    # Store this modified dataset
    if(i == 1) {
      all_imputed <- list(imp_data)
    } else {
      all_imputed[[i]] <- imp_data
    }
  }
  
  cat("✓ Recalculated n_health_conditions for all imputations\n\n")
  
  # Verify calculation
  cat("VERIFICATION:\n")
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  imp_sample <- all_imputed[[1]]
  n_checks <- sum(imp_sample$n_health_conditions == 
                   (imp_sample$n_physical_conditions + 
                    imp_sample$n_ment_conditions + 
                    imp_sample$n_sleep_conditions))
  
  cat("  Checked first imputation:\n")
  cat("  Correct calculations:", n_checks, "/", nrow(imp_sample), "\n")
  if(n_checks == nrow(imp_sample)) {
    cat("  ✓ All values correctly calculated\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("  ⚠️  Some values may be incorrect - investigate!\n\n")
  }
  
  # Save modified imputation object
  saveRDS(all_imputed, "imputed_datasets_list.rds")
  cat("✓ Saved: imputed_datasets_list.rds\n")
  cat("  (List of", length(all_imputed), "complete datasets with n_health_conditions)\n\n")
  
} else {
  cat("No derived variables to recalculate\n\n")
  
  # Save imputed datasets as list
  all_imputed <- list()
  for(i in 1:imp_params$optimal_m) {
    all_imputed[[i]] <- complete(imp_final, i)
  }
  saveRDS(all_imputed, "imputed_datasets_list.rds")
  cat("✓ Saved: imputed_datasets_list.rds\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART F: ADD OUTCOME VARIABLE BACK
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART F: ADDING OUTCOME VARIABLE BACK\n")

if(file.exists("SIMOA_analysis.rds")) {

  } else {
    cat("⚠️  Outcome variable not found in original dataset\n\n")
    saveRDS(all_imputed, "imputed_datasets_final.rds")

} else {
  cat("⚠️  Original dataset not found - cannot add outcome\n\n")

}

# Save the mids object as well
```

## Post-MI Processing

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 9: POST-IMPUTATION PROCESSING
#==============================================================================
# Purpose: 
#   1. Recalculate n_health_conditions for all imputed datasets
#   2. Create validated personality subscales using already-reversed items
#   3. Calculate reliability metrics
# All operations performed on EACH imputed dataset separately
#==============================================================================

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("POST-IMPUTATION PROCESSING\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Load imputed datasets
if(!file.exists("mice_imputation_object.rds") || !file.exists("SIMOA_analysis.rds")) {
  stop("ERROR: Required files not found. Please run Chunk 8 first.")
}

imp_final <- readRDS("mice_imputation_object.rds")
SIMOA_original <- readRDS("SIMOA_analysis.rds")
imp_params <- readRDS("imputation_parameters_optimized.rds")

cat("✓ Loaded MICE object with", imp_final$m, "imputations\n")
cat("  Variables:", ncol(imp_final$data), "\n")
cat("  Observations:", nrow(imp_final$data), "\n\n")

outcome_var <- "scrn_stopped_bzra"

cat("REVERSE CODING STATUS (from Chunk 6):\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  BFI (5 items reversed):\n")
cat("    • reserved (Extraversion, reversed)\n")
cat("    • lazy (Conscientiousness, reversed)\n")
cat("    • relaxed (Neuroticism, reversed)\n")
cat("    • few_interests (Openness, reversed)\n")
cat("    • find_fault (Agreeableness, reversed)\n")
cat("  SURPS (6 items reversed):\n")
cat("    • surps1, surps4, surps7, surps13, surps20, surps23 (Hopelessness, reversed)\n")
cat("  DBAS: No reverse coding needed\n")
cat("  CISS: No reverse coding needed\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# HELPER FUNCTION: SUBSCALE RELIABILITY ASSESSMENT
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

assess_subscale_reliability <- function(data, items, name, scale_range = NULL) {
  
  # Check if all items exist
  missing_items <- items[!items %in% names(data)]
  if(length(missing_items) > 0) {
    return(list(
      name = name,
      n_items = length(items),
      alpha = NA,
      alpha_ci_lower = NA,
      alpha_ci_upper = NA,
      mean_inter_item_r = NA,
      mean = NA,
      sd = NA,
      min = NA,
      max = NA,
      status = "MISSING ITEMS"
    ))
  }
  
  # Extract item data
  item_data <- data %>% 
    select(all_of(items)) %>% 
    na.omit()
  
  n_complete <- nrow(item_data)
  
  # Need at least 10 cases
  if(n_complete < 10) {
    return(list(
      name = name,
      n_items = length(items),
      alpha = NA,
      alpha_ci_lower = NA,
      alpha_ci_upper = NA,
      mean_inter_item_r = NA,
      mean = NA,
      sd = NA,
      min = NA,
      max = NA,
      status = "INSUFFICIENT DATA"
    ))
  }
  
  # Convert to numeric
  item_matrix <- as.data.frame(lapply(item_data, as.numeric))
  
  # Check variance
  item_sds <- sapply(item_matrix, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  if(any(item_sds == 0 | is.na(item_sds))) {
    return(list(
      name = name,
      n_items = length(items),
      alpha = NA,
      alpha_ci_lower = NA,
      alpha_ci_upper = NA,
      mean_inter_item_r = NA,
      mean = NA,
      sd = NA,
      min = NA,
      max = NA,
      status = "NO VARIANCE"
    ))
  }
  
  # Calculate Cronbach's alpha
  alpha_result <- tryCatch({
    psych::alpha(item_matrix, check.keys = FALSE)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  if(is.null(alpha_result)) {
    return(list(
      name = name,
      n_items = length(items),
      alpha = NA,
      alpha_ci_lower = NA,
      alpha_ci_upper = NA,
      mean_inter_item_r = NA,
      mean = NA,
      sd = NA,
      min = NA,
      max = NA,
      status = "ALPHA FAILED"
    ))
  }
  
  # Extract metrics
  alpha <- alpha_result$total$raw_alpha
  alpha_ci_lower <- alpha_result$feldt$lower.ci
  alpha_ci_upper <- alpha_result$feldt$upper.ci
  
  # Inter-item correlations
  cor_matrix <- cor(item_matrix, use = "complete.obs")
  cor_vector <- cor_matrix[lower.tri(cor_matrix)]
  mean_inter_item_r <- mean(cor_vector, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Calculate subscale scores (MEAN)
  subscale_scores <- rowMeans(item_matrix, na.rm = FALSE)
  
  # Descriptive statistics
  mean_score <- mean(subscale_scores, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_score <- sd(subscale_scores, na.rm = TRUE)
  min_score <- min(subscale_scores, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_score <- max(subscale_scores, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Quality assessment
  status <- if(alpha >= 0.70) "GOOD" else if(alpha >= 0.60) "ACCEPTABLE" else "POOR"
  
  return(list(
    name = name,
    n_items = length(items),
    alpha = alpha,
    alpha_ci_lower = alpha_ci_lower,
    alpha_ci_upper = alpha_ci_upper,
    mean_inter_item_r = mean_inter_item_r,
    mean = mean_score,
    sd = sd_score,
    min = min_score,
    max = max_score,
    status = status
  ))
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART A: RECALCULATE n_health_conditions
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART A: RECALCULATING n_health_conditions\n")

cat("Recalculating for all", imp_final$m, "imputations...\n")

# Convert to long format

# Recalculate n_health_conditions
mids_long <- mids_long %>%
  mutate(n_health_conditions = n_physical_conditions + 
                                n_ment_conditions + 
                                n_sleep_conditions)

cat("✓ Recalculated n_health_conditions\n")

# Verify calculation
verification <- mids_long %>%
  filter(.imp == 1) %>%
  mutate(check = (n_health_conditions == (n_physical_conditions + 
                                           n_ment_conditions + 
                                           n_sleep_conditions))) %>%
  summarise(all_correct = all(check, na.rm = TRUE))

if(verification$all_correct) {
  cat("✓ VERIFICATION PASSED: All calculations correct\n\n")
} else {
  cat("⚠️  WARNING: Some calculations may be incorrect\n\n")
}

# Show distribution
cat("n_health_conditions distribution (first imputation):\n")
imp1_check <- mids_long %>% filter(.imp == 1)
summary_stats <- imp1_check %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(n_health_conditions, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(n_health_conditions, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min = min(n_health_conditions, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max = max(n_health_conditions, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
print(summary_stats)
cat("\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART B: CREATE PERSONALITY SUBSCALES
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART B: CREATING PERSONALITY SUBSCALES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Creating subscales using MEAN scores (interpretable on original scale)\n")
cat("IMPORTANT: Using ALREADY-REVERSED items from Chunk 6\n\n")

# Track created subscales
subscales_created <- list()

# B.1. BFI-10: Big Five Personality
cat("B.1. BFI-10 Subscales (using reversed items)\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

# BFI scoring with already-reversed items
# Note: Items marked (R) were reversed in Chunk 6
bfi_subscales <- list(
  Extraversion = c("reserved", "outgoing"),          # reserved already reversed
  Agreeableness = c("find_fault", "trusting"),       # find_fault already reversed
  Conscientiousness = c("lazy", "thorough"),         # lazy already reversed
  Neuroticism = c("relaxed", "nervous"),             # relaxed already reversed
  Openness = c("few_interests", "imagination")       # few_interests already reversed
)

cat("  Subscale composition:\n")
cat("    Extraversion: reserved(R), outgoing\n")
cat("    Agreeableness: find_fault(R), trusting\n")
cat("    Conscientiousness: lazy(R), thorough\n")
cat("    Neuroticism: relaxed(R), nervous\n")
cat("    Openness: few_interests(R), imagination\n")
cat("    (R) = reversed in Chunk 6\n\n")

for(trait in names(bfi_subscales)) {
  items <- bfi_subscales[[trait]]
  
  if(all(items %in% names(mids_long))) {
    var_name <- paste0("BFI_", trait)
    
    mids_long <- mids_long %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(!!var_name := mean(c(!!!syms(items)), na.rm = FALSE)) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    subscales_created$BFI[[trait]] <- list(
      variable = var_name,
      items = items,
      n_items = length(items),
      reversed_items = intersect(items, c("reserved", "lazy", "relaxed", "few_interests", "find_fault"))
    )
    
    cat("  ✓ Created:", var_name, "\n")
  } else {
    cat("  ✗ Skipped:", trait, "(missing items)\n")
  }
}
cat("\n")

# B.2. SURPS: Substance Use Risk Profile
cat("B.2. SURPS Subscales (using reversed items)\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

# SURPS with already-reversed items
# Items 1, 4, 7, 13, 20, 23 (Hopelessness positively-worded) were reversed
surps_subscales <- list(
  Impulsivity = paste0("surps", c(2, 5, 11, 15, 22)),
  Sensation_Seeking = paste0("surps", c(3, 6, 9, 12, 16, 19)),
  Hopelessness = paste0("surps", c(1, 4, 7, 13, 17, 20, 23)),  # 1,4,7,13,20,23 already reversed
  Anxiety_Sensitivity = paste0("surps", c(8, 10, 14, 18, 21))
)

cat("  Subscale composition:\n")
cat("    Hopelessness: surps1(R), surps4(R), surps7(R), surps13(R), surps17, surps20(R), surps23(R)\n")
cat("    (R) = reversed in Chunk 6\n\n")

for(dimension in names(surps_subscales)) {
  items <- surps_subscales[[dimension]]
  
  if(all(items %in% names(mids_long))) {
    var_name <- paste0("SURPS_", dimension)
    
    mids_long <- mids_long %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(!!var_name := mean(c(!!!syms(items)), na.rm = FALSE)) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    subscales_created$SURPS[[dimension]] <- list(
      variable = var_name,
      items = items,
      n_items = length(items),
      reversed_items = intersect(items, paste0("surps", c(1, 4, 7, 13, 20, 23)))
    )
    
    cat("  ✓ Created:", var_name, "\n")
  } else {
    cat("  ✗ Skipped:", dimension, "(missing items)\n")
  }
}
cat("\n")

# B.3. DBAS-16: Dysfunctional Beliefs About Sleep
cat("B.3. DBAS-16 Subscales (no reverse coding needed)\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

dbas_subscales <- list(
  Consequences = paste0("dbas_", c(5, 7, 9, 12, 16)),
  Worry_Helplessness = paste0("dbas_", c(3, 4, 8, 10, 11, 14)),
  Expectations = c("dbas1", "dbas_2"),
  Medications = paste0("dbas_", c(6, 13, 15))
)

for(dimension in names(dbas_subscales)) {
  items <- dbas_subscales[[dimension]]
  
  if(all(items %in% names(mids_long))) {
    var_name <- paste0("DBAS_", dimension)
    
    mids_long <- mids_long %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(!!var_name := mean(c(!!!syms(items)), na.rm = FALSE)) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    subscales_created$DBAS[[dimension]] <- list(
      variable = var_name,
      items = items,
      n_items = length(items),
      reversed_items = character(0)
    )
    
    cat("  ✓ Created:", var_name, "\n")
  } else {
    cat("  ✗ Skipped:", dimension, "(missing items)\n")
  }
}

# DBAS Total
all_dbas_items <- c("dbas1", paste0("dbas_", 2:16))
if(all(all_dbas_items %in% names(mids_long))) {
  mids_long <- mids_long %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(DBAS_Total = mean(c(!!!syms(all_dbas_items)), na.rm = FALSE)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  subscales_created$DBAS[["Total"]] <- list(
    variable = "DBAS_Total",
    items = all_dbas_items,
    n_items = length(all_dbas_items),
    reversed_items = character(0)
  )
  
  cat("  ✓ Created: DBAS_Total\n")
}
cat("\n")

# B.4. CISS: Coping Inventory for Stressful Situations
cat("B.4. CISS Subscales (no reverse coding needed)\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

ciss_subscales <- list(
  Task = paste0("ciss", c(2, 6, 8, 11, 13, 16, 19)),
  Emotion = paste0("ciss", c(3, 5, 10, 12, 14, 17, 20)),
  Avoidance = paste0("ciss", c(1, 4, 7, 9, 15, 18, 21))
)

for(dimension in names(ciss_subscales)) {
  items <- ciss_subscales[[dimension]]
  
  if(all(items %in% names(mids_long))) {
    var_name <- paste0("CISS_", dimension)
    
    mids_long <- mids_long %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(!!var_name := mean(c(!!!syms(items)), na.rm = FALSE)) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    subscales_created$CISS[[dimension]] <- list(
      variable = var_name,
      items = items,
      n_items = length(items),
      reversed_items = character(0)
    )
    
    cat("  ✓ Created:", var_name, "\n")
  } else {
    cat("  ✗ Skipped:", dimension, "(missing items)\n")
  }
}
cat("\n")

# Count subscales
n_total_subscales <- sum(
  length(subscales_created$BFI),
  length(subscales_created$SURPS),
  length(subscales_created$DBAS),
  length(subscales_created$CISS)
)

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("SUBSCALE CREATION SUMMARY:\n")
cat("  Total subscales created:", n_total_subscales, "\n")
cat("  • BFI-10:", length(subscales_created$BFI), "(all using reversed items)\n")
cat("  • SURPS:", length(subscales_created$SURPS), "(Hopelessness using reversed items)\n")
cat("  • DBAS-16:", length(subscales_created$DBAS), "(no reversal needed)\n")
cat("  • CISS:", length(subscales_created$CISS), "(no reversal needed)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART C: RELIABILITY ASSESSMENT
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART C: RELIABILITY ASSESSMENT\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Assessing reliability using first imputed dataset...\n\n")

# Get first imputation
data_imp1 <- mids_long %>% filter(.imp == 1) %>% select(-.imp, -.id)

# Assess all subscales
reliability_results <- list()

cat("BFI-10 SUBSCALES:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
for(trait in names(subscales_created$BFI)) {
  subscale_info <- subscales_created$BFI[[trait]]
  result <- assess_subscale_reliability(
    data = data_imp1,
    items = subscale_info$items,
    name = paste0("BFI_", trait),
    scale_range = c(1, 5)
  )
  reliability_results[[subscale_info$variable]] <- result
  
  cat(sprintf("  %s: α = %.3f [%.3f, %.3f], M = %.2f (SD = %.2f)\n",
              trait, result$alpha, result$alpha_ci_lower, 
              result$alpha_ci_upper, result$mean, result$sd))
}
cat("\n")

cat("SURPS SUBSCALES:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
for(dimension in names(subscales_created$SURPS)) {
  subscale_info <- subscales_created$SURPS[[dimension]]
  result <- assess_subscale_reliability(
    data = data_imp1,
    items = subscale_info$items,
    name = paste0("SURPS_", dimension),
    scale_range = c(1, 4)
  )
  reliability_results[[subscale_info$variable]] <- result
  
  cat(sprintf("  %s: α = %.3f [%.3f, %.3f], M = %.2f (SD = %.2f)\n",
              dimension, result$alpha, result$alpha_ci_lower, 
              result$alpha_ci_upper, result$mean, result$sd))
}
cat("\n")

cat("DBAS-16 SUBSCALES:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
for(dimension in names(subscales_created$DBAS)) {
  subscale_info <- subscales_created$DBAS[[dimension]]
  result <- assess_subscale_reliability(
    data = data_imp1,
    items = subscale_info$items,
    name = paste0("DBAS_", dimension),
    scale_range = c(0, 10)
  )
  reliability_results[[subscale_info$variable]] <- result
  
  cat(sprintf("  %s: α = %.3f [%.3f, %.3f], M = %.2f (SD = %.2f)\n",
              dimension, result$alpha, result$alpha_ci_lower, 
              result$alpha_ci_upper, result$mean, result$sd))
}
cat("\n")

cat("CISS SUBSCALES:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
for(dimension in names(subscales_created$CISS)) {
  subscale_info <- subscales_created$CISS[[dimension]]
  result <- assess_subscale_reliability(
    data = data_imp1,
    items = subscale_info$items,
    name = paste0("CISS_", dimension),
    scale_range = c(1, 5)
  )
  reliability_results[[subscale_info$variable]] <- result
  
  cat(sprintf("  %s: α = %.3f [%.3f, %.3f], M = %.2f (SD = %.2f)\n",
              dimension, result$alpha, result$alpha_ci_lower, 
              result$alpha_ci_upper, result$mean, result$sd))
}
cat("\n")

# Create summary table
summary_table <- data.frame()
for(var_name in names(reliability_results)) {
  result <- reliability_results[[var_name]]
  
  # Get reversed items info
  reversed_count <- 0
  for(measure in names(subscales_created)) {
    for(subscale in names(subscales_created[[measure]])) {
      if(subscales_created[[measure]][[subscale]]$variable == var_name) {
        reversed_count <- length(subscales_created[[measure]][[subscale]]$reversed_items)
        break
      }
    }
  }
  
  summary_table <- rbind(summary_table, data.frame(
    Subscale = result$name,
    N_Items = result$n_items,
    N_Reversed = reversed_count,
    Alpha = result$alpha,
    CI_Lower = result$alpha_ci_lower,
    CI_Upper = result$alpha_ci_upper,
    Mean = result$mean,
    SD = result$sd,
    Status = result$status,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ))
}

write.csv(summary_table, "subscale_reliability_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("✓ Saved: subscale_reliability_summary.csv\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART D: ADD OUTCOME VARIABLE
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART D: ADDING OUTCOME VARIABLE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

if(outcome_var %in% names(SIMOA_original)) {
  outcome_data <- SIMOA_original[[outcome_var]]
  mids_long[[outcome_var]] <- rep(outcome_data, times = imp_final$m + 1)
  
  cat("✓ Added outcome variable:", outcome_var, "\n")
  cat("  Distribution:\n")
  print(table(outcome_data, useNA = "ifany"))
  cat("\n")
} else {
  cat("⚠️  Outcome variable not found\n\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART E: CONVERT BACK TO MIDS AND SAVE
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART E: FINALIZING AND SAVING\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Convert back to mids
imp_with_subscales <- as.mids(mids_long)

cat("✓ Converted to mids object\n")
cat("  Variables:", ncol(imp_with_subscales$data), "\n")
cat("  Subscales added:", n_total_subscales, "\n")
cat("  n_health_conditions: recalculated\n\n")

# Save mids object
saveRDS(imp_with_subscales, "imputed_data_with_subscales.rds")
cat("✓ Saved: imputed_data_with_subscales.rds\n")

# Save as list of complete datasets too
all_imputed_complete <- list()
for(i in 1:imp_with_subscales$m) {
  all_imputed_complete[[i]] <- complete(imp_with_subscales, i)
}
saveRDS(all_imputed_complete, "imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds")
cat("✓ Saved: imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds (list of", length(all_imputed_complete), "datasets)\n")

# Save reliability and subscale info
saveRDS(list(
  subscales_created = subscales_created,
  reliability_results = reliability_results,
  summary_table = summary_table
), "subscale_metadata.rds")
cat("✓ Saved: subscale_metadata.rds\n")

# Save example dataset
example_data <- complete(imp_with_subscales, 1)
write.csv(example_data, "imputed_example_with_subscales.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("✓ Saved: imputed_example_with_subscales.csv\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PART F: VALIDATION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART F: VALIDATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

validation_passed <- TRUE

# Check 1: n_health_conditions
cat("1. Validating n_health_conditions...\n")
for(i in 1:imp_with_subscales$m) {
  imp_data <- complete(imp_with_subscales, i)
  check <- all(imp_data$n_health_conditions == 
                (imp_data$n_physical_conditions + 
                 imp_data$n_ment_conditions + 
                 imp_data$n_sleep_conditions), na.rm = TRUE)
  if(check) {
    cat(sprintf("  ✓ Imputation %d: Correct\n", i))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("  ✗ Imputation %d: INCORRECT\n", i))
    validation_passed <- FALSE
  }
}
cat("\n")

# Check 2: Subscales exist
cat("2. Validating subscale creation...\n")
all_subscale_vars <- c()
for(measure in names(subscales_created)) {
  for(subscale in names(subscales_created[[measure]])) {
    var_name <- subscales_created[[measure]][[subscale]]$variable
    all_subscale_vars <- c(all_subscale_vars, var_name)
  }
}

imp1_data <- complete(imp_with_subscales, 1)
for(var in all_subscale_vars) {
  if(var %in% names(imp1_data)) {
    n_complete <- sum(!is.na(imp1_data[[var]]))
    cat(sprintf("  ✓ %-30s: %d/%d complete\n", var, n_complete, nrow(imp1_data)))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("  ✗ %-30s: MISSING\n", var))
    validation_passed <- FALSE
  }
}
cat("\n")

# Check 3: Reversed items verification
cat("3. Verifying reversed items are included...\n")
all_reversed_items <- c(
  "reserved", "lazy", "relaxed", "few_interests", "find_fault",
  paste0("surps", c(1, 4, 7, 13, 20, 23))
)
for(item in all_reversed_items) {
  if(item %in% names(imp1_data)) {
    cat(sprintf("  ✓ %s present\n", item))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("  ✗ %s MISSING\n", item))
    validation_passed <- FALSE
  }
}
cat("\n")

# Check 4: Outcome variable
cat("4. Validating outcome variable...\n")
if(outcome_var %in% names(imp1_data)) {
  cat(sprintf("  ✓ %s present\n", outcome_var))
} else {
  cat(sprintf("  ✗ %s MISSING\n", outcome_var))
  validation_passed <- FALSE
}
cat("\n")

# Final summary
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
if(validation_passed) {
  cat("✅ ALL VALIDATION CHECKS PASSED\n")
  cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
  
  cat("PROCESSING COMPLETE:\n")
  cat("  ✓ n_health_conditions recalculated for all", imp_with_subscales$m, "imputations\n")
  cat("  ✓", n_total_subscales, "personality subscales created\n")
  cat("  ✓ All subscales use ALREADY-REVERSED items from Chunk 6\n")
  cat("  ✓ Reliability assessed (see summary table)\n")
  cat("  ✓ Outcome variable added\n")
  cat("  ✓ All datasets validated\n\n")
  
  cat("READY FOR ANALYSIS:\n")
  cat("  → Load 'imputed_data_with_subscales.rds' for mice pooling\n")
  cat("  → Or load 'imputed_datasets_complete_final.rds' for manual pooling\n")
  cat("  → Review 'subscale_reliability_summary.csv' for reliability\n\n")
  
} else {
  cat("⚠️  VALIDATION FAILED\n")
  cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
  cat("Review errors above before proceeding\n\n")
}

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("✓ POST-IMPUTATION PROCESSING COMPLETE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
```
